clusters.hook: 字根 frag/fract＝碎——修復站專管碎片、分數與難搞。
clusters.script: fragment／fragmentary 樣本碎成片。fracture 裂縫報告。fraction／fractional 分數切片。fragile／frail 易碎玻璃；refract 折射光線——站長：fragmentary evidence 要標；fragile egos 別擋勘誤。

members.speakLineEn: Archive every fragment of the raw log.
members.speakLineZh: 保存原始日誌每一碎片。

members.speakLineEn: Fragmentary evidence needs cautious claims.
members.speakLineZh: 片斷證據需要謹慎主張。

members.speakLineEn: A fracture in the protocol must be logged.
members.speakLineZh: 規程裂縫必須記錄。

members.speakLineEn: Report the excluded fraction with reasons.
members.speakLineZh: 報告排除分數並附理由。

members.speakLineEn: Even a fractional leak of outcomes matters.
members.speakLineZh: 結局哪怕微小洩漏也重要。

members.speakLineEn: Fragile findings need replication.
members.speakLineZh: 易碎發現需要複現。

members.senseAnchor: the weight of a frail (basket) full of raisins or figs; between 50 and 75 pounds; a basket for holding dried fruit (especially raisins or figs)
members.speakLineEn: A frail identification strategy collapses.
members.speakLineZh: 虛弱識別策略會塌。

members.speakLineEn: Do not refract critique into personal attack.
members.speakLineZh: 別把批評折射成人身攻擊。

members.senseAnchor: a crime less serious than a felony
members.speakLineEn: An infraction of blinding rules voids trust.
members.speakLineZh: 違反盲法規則摧毀信任。

members.speakLineEn: Think of bias as diffraction around design gaps.
members.speakLineZh: 把偏差當設計缺口的繞射。

members.senseAnchor: break into many pieces; damage or destroy
members.speakLineEn: One silent fork can shatter credibility.
members.speakLineZh: 一次沉默分叉可粉碎可信度。

members.speakLineEn: Each shard of code needs a commit message.
members.speakLineZh: 每片程式碼碎片需要 commit 訊息。

clusters.hook: 字根 fus＝澆、熔——工廠把東西澆在一起或澆散。
clusters.script: infuse 注入；profuse 澆得過多。effusive 感情傾瀉；diffuse 擴散澆開。confuse 混澆搞糊；refuse 拒絕不收澆。suffuse 瀰漫；transfuse 輸注。fusion 熔合；infusion 浸泡注入。
pitfalls: diffuse 可作動詞擴散或形容詞冗散

members.speakLineEn: Infuse humility into the discussion section.
members.speakLineZh: 把謙遜注入討論段。

members.senseAnchor: produced or growing in extreme abundance
members.speakLineEn: Profuse acknowledgments cannot replace methods detail.
members.speakLineZh: 大量誌謝不能取代方法細節。

members.speakLineEn: Effusive praise in reviews can hide critique.
members.speakLineZh: 洋溢讚美可能掩蓋批評。

members.speakLineEn: Diffuse aims produce unfocused papers.
members.speakLineZh: 目標冗散產出失焦論文。

members.speakLineEn: Do not confuse significance with importance.
members.speakLineZh: 不要把顯著性與重要性混淆。

members.speakLineEn: Refuse silent outcome switching.
members.speakLineZh: 拒絕沉默更換結局變項。

members.speakLineEn: Anxiety can suffuse a lab after a retraction.
members.speakLineZh: 撤稿後焦慮可瀰漫實驗室。

members.speakLineEn: Transfuse lessons from failed trials into protocols.
members.speakLineZh: 把失敗試驗教訓輸進規程。

members.speakLineEn: Interdisciplinary fusion needs shared measures.
members.speakLineZh: 跨領域融合需要共享測量。

members.speakLineEn: An infusion of new coders needs training.
members.speakLineZh: 新編碼員注入需要訓練。

members.speakLineEn: Document refusal rates in surveys.
members.speakLineZh: 記錄調查拒絕率。

members.speakLineEn: Category confusion inflates error bars.
members.speakLineZh: 類別混淆膨脹誤差。

clusters.hook: 字根 gen＝生、種——產房專管「生出什麼」。
clusters.script: congenital 一生下來就帶著；progeny 是子孫產線。ingenious 巧思生出妙招，ingenuous 天真得像剛出生。homogeneous 同種，heterogeneous 雜種混生；engender 催生出結果，genesis 起源故事，genealogy 家譜，genocide 滅種暴行。
reviewHooks: ingenious 巧妙 ≠ ingenuous 天真
pitfalls: congenital 先天 ≠ congenital 勿寫成 congential

members.senseAnchor: present at birth but not necessarily hereditary; acquired during fetal development
members.speakLineEn: Congenital defects need early screening.
members.speakLineZh: 先天缺陷需要早期篩檢。

members.senseAnchor: the immediate descendants of a person
members.speakLineEn: Ideas leave intellectual progeny in later papers.
members.speakLineZh: 想法在後續論文留下思想後代。

members.speakLineEn: An ingenious design saved sample size.
members.speakLineZh: 巧妙設計省下樣本量。

members.senseAnchor: characterized by an inability to mask your feelings; not devious; lacking in sophistication or worldliness
members.speakLineEn: Her ingenuous question exposed the hidden assumption.
members.speakLineZh: 她率直的問題揭開隱藏假設。

members.speakLineEn: A homogeneous sample limits external validity.
members.speakLineZh: 同質樣本限制外部效度。

members.speakLineEn: Heterogeneous effects hide in average treatment effects.
members.speakLineZh: 異質效應藏在平均處理效應裡。

members.speakLineEn: Ambiguous rubrics engender grading disputes.
members.speakLineZh: 模糊評分規準催生爭議。

members.senseAnchor: a coming into being; the first book of the Old Testament: tells of Creation; Adam and Eve; the Fall of Man; Cain and Abel; Noah and the flood; God's covenant with Abraham; Abraham and Isaac; Jacob and Esau; Joseph and his brothers
members.speakLineEn: The genesis of the theory was a failed replication.
members.speakLineZh: 該理論起源於一次失敗複現。

members.senseAnchor: successive generations of kin; the study or investigation of ancestry and family history
members.speakLineEn: A genealogy of methods shows forgotten branches.
members.speakLineZh: 方法系譜顯示被遺忘的分支。

members.speakLineEn: The term genocide carries legal and moral weight.
members.speakLineZh: 種族滅絕一詞具有法律與道德重量。

members.speakLineEn: Generic advice rarely fits local constraints.
members.speakLineZh: 通用建議很少符合在地限制。

members.speakLineEn: Indigenous knowledge can correct outsider models.
members.speakLineZh: 本土知識能校正外來模型。

clusters.hook: 字根 graph/gram＝寫／圖——繪圖司專管圖表、電報與文法墨水。
clusters.script: graph／graphic 把結果畫出來。diagram 流程圖牆。telegram 短訊急報。grammar／epigram 句法與警句墨水；autograph 簽名蓋章——司長：graphic clarity 加分；epigram 不能取代 ident。

members.speakLineEn: Put the primary graph in the abstract figure.
members.speakLineZh: 把主圖放進摘要圖。

members.speakLineEn: Use graphic clarity, not graphic drama.
members.speakLineZh: 要圖形清晰，不要圖形戲劇。

members.speakLineEn: A diagram of exclusions belongs in methods.
members.speakLineZh: 排除示意圖應在方法段。

members.speakLineEn: Send a telegram-length correction notice.
members.speakLineZh: 發電報長度的勘誤通知。

members.speakLineEn: Broken grammar in code comments breeds bugs.
members.speakLineZh: 註解文法壞掉會滋生錯誤。

members.speakLineEn: An epigram is not a causal claim.
members.speakLineZh: 警句不是因果主張。

members.speakLineEn: Do not treat an autograph as peer review.
members.speakLineZh: 別把簽名當同儕審查。

members.speakLineEn: A methods biography should list forks.
members.speakLineZh: 方法傳記應列出分叉。

members.speakLineEn: One claim per paragraph, then evidence.
members.speakLineZh: 一段一主張，再給證據。

members.speakLineEn: Stamp a monogram on locked code.
members.speakLineZh: 在鎖定程式碼蓋上標記。

members.speakLineEn: Trace uncertainty with a graphite pencil first.
members.speakLineZh: 先用石墨筆描不確定。

members.speakLineEn: Sensitivity cartography maps assumption land.
members.speakLineZh: 敏感度製圖學畫出假設地圖。

clusters.hook: 字根 greg＝群——牧場專管聚在一起或被分開。
clusters.script: gregarious 愛群聚；congregate 聚集。segregate 隔離分群；aggregate 總合成群。egregious 糟到「出群」顯眼；congregation 會眾。desegregate 取消隔離。
pitfalls: egregious＝極壞／驚人地糟，不是「卓越」古義常用於現代貶義

members.senseAnchor: likely to seek or enjoy the company of others
members.speakLineEn: Gregarious networking still needs quiet writing time.
members.speakLineZh: 合群交際仍需安靜寫作時間。

members.speakLineEn: Do not let p-hackers congregate around one metric.
members.speakLineZh: 別讓 p 操弄者圍聚單一指標。

members.senseAnchor: someone who is or has been segregated; separate by race or religion; practice a policy of racial segregation
members.speakLineEn: Segregate exploratory from confirmatory analyses.
members.speakLineZh: 把探索與驗證分析隔離。

members.speakLineEn: Report both aggregate and subgroup effects.
members.speakLineZh: 同時報告總體與次群效應。

members.senseAnchor: conspicuously and outrageously bad or reprehensible
members.speakLineEn: Egregious selective reporting invites sanctions.
members.speakLineZh: 過分選擇性報告招致處罰。

members.speakLineEn: The congregation of stakeholders delayed the protocol.
members.speakLineZh: 利害關係人聚集拖延規程。

members.speakLineEn: Desegregate methods training across departments.
members.speakLineZh: 跨系廢除方法訓練隔離。

members.speakLineEn: Aggregative indices can hide harm.
members.speakLineZh: 聚合指標可能掩蓋傷害。

members.speakLineEn: Outcome segregation by gender needs justification.
members.speakLineZh: 依性別隔離結局需理由。

members.speakLineEn: Each congregant signed a conflict form.
members.speakLineZh: 每位成員簽署利益衝突表。

members.speakLineEn: The figure was egregiously cropped.
members.speakLineZh: 圖被過分裁切。

members.senseAnchor: the quality of being gregarious--having a dislike of being alone
members.speakLineEn: Gregariousness ≠ scientific rigor.
members.speakLineZh: 合群性不等於科學嚴謹。

clusters.hook: 字根 grad/gress＝走、步——誰進步誰退步看腳步。
clusters.script: 社會要 progress 向前走；失敗就 regress 退步。aggressive 人步步進逼，digress 演講走歪路。congress 走到一起開會；egress 是出口那一步。grade 是階梯等級，gradual 一步一步。
reviewHooks: gress＝走：progress 前進、regress 後退、digress 離題走、aggressive 進逼
pitfalls: digress（離題）不是 digressive 就一定壞——有時是風格，但考試常標『偏離主線』
aggressive 中性可指積極，語境常帶攻擊性

members.speakLineEn: Progress requires measurable milestones.
members.speakLineZh: 進步需要可測量的里程碑。

members.senseAnchor: the reasoning involved when you assume the conclusion is true and reason backward to the evidence; returning to a former state
members.speakLineEn: Under stress, teams may regress to safer routines.
members.speakLineZh: 壓力下團隊可能退回更安全的例行做法。

members.speakLineEn: Aggressive coding can introduce new bugs.
members.speakLineZh: 過度積極的編碼可能引入新錯誤。

members.senseAnchor: lose clarity or turn aside especially from the main subject of attention or course of argument in writing, thinking, or speaking; wander from a direct or straight course
members.speakLineEn: Let me digress briefly, then return to the claim.
members.speakLineZh: 容我短暫離題，再回到主張。

members.speakLineEn: The congress of specialists produced a joint statement.
members.speakLineZh: 專家大會產出了聯合聲明。

members.speakLineEn: Clear egress routes are part of lab safety.
members.speakLineZh: 清楚的出口動線是實驗室安全的一部分。

members.speakLineEn: We grade evidence by design quality, not by hype.
members.speakLineZh: 我們依設計品質評分證據，而非依炒作。

members.speakLineEn: Change was gradual rather than revolutionary.
members.speakLineZh: 改變是逐漸的，而非革命性的。

members.speakLineEn: Noise can degrade signal quality.
members.speakLineZh: 噪音會降低訊號品質。

members.speakLineEn: The policy looks retrograde by current standards.
members.speakLineZh: 以現行標準看，該政策顯得倒退。

members.senseAnchor: to fail to keep the rule
members.speakLineEn: To transgress the protocol voids the trial.
members.speakLineZh: 逾越協議會使試驗無效。

content: gress＝走：progress 前進、regress 後退、digress 離題走、aggressive 進逼

clusters.hook: 字根 her/hes＝黏——要嘛黏住，要嘛猶豫不黏。
clusters.script: adhere 黏附遵守；adhesive 黏著劑。coherent／cohesive 黏成一貫。inherent 內在黏著的本質。hesitate／hesitant 猶豫不黏定。incoherent 黏不起來。
pitfalls: coherent（論理一貫）≠ cohesive（群體凝聚力）略有分工

members.speakLineEn: Adhere to the preregistered plan.
members.speakLineZh: 遵守預註冊計畫。

members.speakLineEn: An adhesive label marked blinded samples.
members.speakLineZh: 黏標標記盲樣。

members.speakLineEn: Keep the causal story coherent.
members.speakLineZh: 讓因果故事連貫。

members.senseAnchor: causing cohesion; cohering or tending to cohere; well integrated
members.speakLineEn: A cohesive team still needs dissent channels.
members.speakLineZh: 有凝聚力的團隊仍需異議通道。

members.senseAnchor: existing as an essential constituent or characteristic; in the nature of something though not readily apparent
members.speakLineEn: Noise is inherent in survey measures.
members.speakLineZh: 噪音是調查測量固有的。

members.speakLineEn: Do not hesitate to report nulls.
members.speakLineZh: 不要猶豫報告虛無結果。

members.speakLineEn: Hesitant leadership delays corrections.
members.speakLineZh: 猶豫領導拖延勘誤。

members.speakLineEn: Incoherent constructs fail validation.
members.speakLineZh: 不連貫構念無法驗證。

members.speakLineEn: Hesitation before submission beats rushed errors.
members.speakLineZh: 投稿前猶豫勝過倉促錯誤。

members.speakLineEn: Measure adherence to the intervention.
members.speakLineZh: 測量介入依從度。

members.speakLineEn: Check coherence across sections.
members.speakLineZh: 檢查各節連貫性。

members.speakLineEn: Do not treat preference as inherence.
members.speakLineZh: 不要把偏好當固有本質。

members.speakLineEn: Reviewers may reject a paper for design flaws.
members.speakLineZh: 審查者可能因設計缺陷駁回論文。

members.speakLineEn: Inject one clarifying example into the paragraph.
members.speakLineZh: 在段落中注入一個澄清例子。

members.speakLineEn: Do not project motives without evidence.
members.speakLineZh: 沒有證據就不要投射動機。

members.speakLineEn: The conclusion is still conjecture, not proof.
members.speakLineZh: 結論仍是臆測，不是證明。

members.speakLineEn: Security ejected disruptors from the hall.
members.speakLineZh: 保全把搗亂者驅離會場。

members.speakLineEn: Subjects were randomly assigned to conditions.
members.speakLineZh: 受試者被隨機分到各條件。

members.speakLineEn: Counsel objected to the leading question.
members.speakLineZh: 律師對誘導性問題提出異議。

members.zhGloss: 悲慘的；下流的；徹底的（貶）
members.senseAnchor: of the most contemptible kind; most unfortunate or miserable
members.speakLineEn: Abject failure forced a redesign of the study.
members.speakLineZh: 徹底慘敗迫使研究重新設計。

members.speakLineEn: Career trajectory is not destiny.
members.speakLineZh: 職涯軌跡不是命運。

members.speakLineEn: Please do not interject until the claim is finished.
members.speakLineZh: 請等論點說完再插話。

members.speakLineEn: A metaphor can become a rhetorical projectile.
members.speakLineZh: 隱喻可能變成修辭拋射物。

clusters.hook: 字根 jud/jur/jus＝法、判——誰來審。
clusters.script: judge 法官／判斷，judicial 司法的，judicious 明斷的。prejudice 預先判決，adjudicate 裁決。jury 陪審團，juridical 法律上的，justice 正義，justify 辯護使正當，injustice 不義，jurisdiction 已在 dict 族——這裡看 perjury 偽證，injury 傷害。

members.speakLineEn: Judge models by out-of-sample performance.
members.speakLineZh: 用樣本外表現判斷模型。

members.senseAnchor: decreed by or proceeding from a court of justice; belonging or appropriate to the office of a judge
members.speakLineEn: Keep a judicial separation between exploration and confirmation.
members.speakLineZh: 探索與確認保持司法式分離。

members.speakLineEn: Judicious pruning of covariates beats kitchen-sink models.
members.speakLineZh: 審慎修剪共變勝過一鍋炒。

members.speakLineEn: Prejudice enters when labels leak into coding.
members.speakLineZh: 標籤洩漏進編碼時偏見進入。

members.senseAnchor: to hear and settle a case, dispute or conflict
members.speakLineEn: Let a precommitted rule adjudicate borderline cases.
members.speakLineZh: 用預先承諾規則裁決邊界案例。

members.speakLineEn: A jury of peers still needs conflict disclosures.
members.speakLineZh: 同儕陪審仍需利益揭露。

members.speakLineEn: Procedural justice matters in authorship disputes.
members.speakLineZh: 作者權爭議中程序正義重要。

members.speakLineEn: Justify each exclusion in one sentence.
members.speakLineZh: 每項排除用一句話證明正當。

members.speakLineEn: Citation injustice tracks prestige gradients.
members.speakLineZh: 引用不義追蹤聲望梯度。

members.senseAnchor: criminal offense of making false statements under oath
members.speakLineEn: Fabrication is the perjury of science.
members.speakLineZh: 造假是科學的偽證。

members.speakLineEn: Underpowered studies can still cause injury via false hope.
members.speakLineZh: 低檢定力研究仍可透過假希望造成傷害。

members.speakLineEn: Juridical metaphors help, but biology is not a courtroom.
members.speakLineZh: 法律隱喻有用，但生物不是法庭。

members.speakLineEn: Suspend judgment until diagnostics are clean.
members.speakLineZh: 診斷乾淨前先懸置判斷。

members.speakLineEn: Prejudicial language in reviews should be edited out.
members.speakLineZh: 審稿中的偏見語言應刪除。

members.speakLineEn: Unjust authorship norms waste talent.
members.speakLineZh: 不公正作者規範浪費人才。

clusters.hook: 字根 junct＝連接——調度台專管接點與禁令。
clusters.script: junction 交叉接點；juncture 關鍵時刻接點。conjunction 合取連接；disjunction 析取分開。injunction 禁制令；adjunct 附加連接物。subjugate 壓下去統治；conjunct 連接的。

members.speakLineEn: At the junction of ethics and incentives, document both.
members.speakLineZh: 在倫理與誘因接點，兩者都記錄。

members.senseAnchor: an event that occurs at a critical time; a crisis situation or point in time when a critical decision must be made
members.speakLineEn: This juncture calls for a registered report.
members.speakLineZh: 此刻需要註冊報告。

members.speakLineEn: In conjunction with sensitivity checks, re-estimate.
members.speakLineZh: 結合敏感度檢查再估計。

members.speakLineEn: Theory–data disjunction weakens the paper.
members.speakLineZh: 理論與資料分離削弱論文。

members.speakLineEn: An injunction blocked further scraping.
members.speakLineZh: 禁制令阻擋繼續爬取。

members.senseAnchor: something joined or added to another thing but not essentially a part of it
members.speakLineEn: Treat a blog post as an adjunct, not primary evidence.
members.speakLineZh: 部落格當附屬非主要證據。

members.senseAnchor: put down by force or intimidation; make subservient; force to submit or subdue
members.speakLineEn: Do not subjugate methods to marketing.
members.speakLineZh: 不要讓方法屈服於行銷。

members.speakLineEn: Conjunct hypotheses need joint tests.
members.speakLineZh: 結合假說需要聯合檢定。

members.speakLineEn: Injunctive norms shape lab culture.
members.speakLineZh: 勸告性規範形塑實驗室文化。

members.speakLineEn: Joined datasets need linkage audits.
members.speakLineZh: 已連接資料集需連結稽核。

members.speakLineEn: Rejoin the consortium after fixing leaks.
members.speakLineZh: 修補洩漏後再加入聯盟。

members.speakLineEn: Use disjoint training and test sets.
members.speakLineZh: 使用不相交訓練／測試集。

clusters.hook: 字根 lat＝邊／帶——快遞局只走側門：橫向、拉開、連帶責任全包。
clusters.script: lateral 側滑閃人；relative／relation／relate 把親戚網路連起來。dilate 把瞳孔拉開；elated 開心到飄。collate／collateral／translate 核對、抵押、翻譯——局長：lateral thinking 可以；collateral damage 不行。

members.senseAnchor: a pass to a receiver upfield from the passer; situated at or extending to the side; ; - Tennyson
members.speakLineEn: Try a lateral check, not a louder claim.
members.speakLineZh: 試橫向檢查，不是更大聲主張。

members.speakLineEn: Effect sizes are relative to the baseline.
members.speakLineZh: 效應量相對基準而言。

members.speakLineEn: State the relation you actually identified.
members.speakLineZh: 說清楚你真正識別的關係。

members.speakLineEn: Relate the result to the preregistered estimand.
members.speakLineZh: 把結果連回預註冊目標量。

members.senseAnchor: become wider; add details, as to an account or idea; clarify the meaning of and discourse in a learned way, usually in writing
members.speakLineEn: Do not dilate anecdotes into causal proof.
members.speakLineZh: 別把軼事擴成因果證明。

members.senseAnchor: fill with high spirits; fill with optimism; exultantly proud and joyful; in high spirits
members.speakLineEn: Stay curious when elated by a significant p.
members.speakLineZh: 被顯著 p 沖昏時仍保持好奇。

members.senseAnchor: compare critically; of texts; to assemble in proper sequence
members.speakLineEn: Collate code, data, and codebook before submission.
members.speakLineZh: 投稿前核對程式、資料與編碼簿。

members.speakLineEn: Translate methods into plain language for readers.
members.speakLineZh: 把方法翻譯成讀者能懂的話。

members.speakLineEn: Avoid collateral harm to trust when rushing.
members.speakLineZh: 趕工時避免傷及信任。

members.speakLineEn: Even a prelate of the field needs peer review.
members.speakLineZh: 領域大佬也需要同儕審查。

members.speakLineEn: Report latitudinal variation across sites.
members.speakLineZh: 報告跨站點的幅度差異。

members.speakLineEn: Do not sidestep limitations in the discussion.
members.speakLineZh: 討論段不要側步避開限制。

members.senseAnchor: qualified for or allowed or worthy of being chosen
members.speakLineEn: Only preregistered trials were eligible for pooling.
members.speakLineZh: 只有預註冊試驗有資格納入合併。

members.speakLineEn: Illegible field notes waste months of fieldwork.
members.speakLineZh: 難辨田野筆記浪費數月。

members.senseAnchor: failure to act with the prudence that a reasonable person would exercise under the same circumstances; the trait of neglecting responsibilities and lacking concern
members.speakLineEn: Negligence in consent forms invites sanctions.
members.speakLineZh: 知情同意疏忽招致處罰。

members.senseAnchor: to give someone a lower or less important position than before
members.speakLineEn: Do not relegate ethics to an appendix.
members.speakLineZh: 不要把倫理貶到附錄。

members.speakLineEn: The figure legend must define every symbol.
members.speakLineZh: 圖例必須定義每個符號。

members.speakLineEn: Make axis labels legible at slide distance.
members.speakLineZh: 軸標籤在投影距離也要可讀。

members.speakLineEn: Discipline dialect can exclude outsiders.
members.speakLineZh: 學科語體可能排除外人。

members.senseAnchor: composed of elements drawn from various sources
members.speakLineEn: An eclectic toolkit still needs coherence.
members.speakLineZh: 兼收並蓄工具箱仍需一貫性。

members.speakLineEn: A predilection for novelty biases publication.
members.speakLineZh: 嗜新偏愛扭曲發表。

members.senseAnchor: blasphemous behavior; the act of depriving something of its sacred character
members.speakLineEn: Treating raw data casually feels like methodological sacrilege.
members.speakLineZh: 隨意對待原始資料像方法論褻瀆。

members.senseAnchor: persons who make or amend or repeal laws
members.speakLineEn: The legislature funded open-data mandates.
members.speakLineZh: 立法機關資助開放資料強制令。

members.speakLineEn: Collective action problems stall reforms.
members.speakLineZh: 集體行動困境拖延改革。

clusters.script: alleviate 減輕；elevate 抬高。levity 輕浮；levy 徵收（抽起來）。leverage 槓桿用力；relevant／irrelevant 相關舉得上／舉不上。leaven 發酵舉起；lever 槓桿。

members.senseAnchor: provide physical relief, as from pain; make easier
members.speakLineEn: Better measures alleviate some bias, not all.
members.speakLineZh: 更好測量減輕部分偏差，非全部。

members.speakLineEn: Elevate replication to equal status with novelty.
members.speakLineZh: 把複現提升到與新奇同等地位。

members.senseAnchor: feeling an inappropriate lack of seriousness; a manner lacking seriousness
members.speakLineEn: Levity about fraud norms is dangerous.
members.speakLineZh: 對造假規範輕浮很危險。

members.senseAnchor: a charge imposed and collected; the act of drafting into military service
members.speakLineEn: Levy a cost on undisclosed exclusions.
members.speakLineZh: 對未揭露排除課以成本。

members.speakLineEn: Leverage open tools instead of proprietary black boxes.
members.speakLineZh: 利用開放工具而非專有黑箱。

members.speakLineEn: Keep only relevant covariates.
members.speakLineZh: 只保留相關共變項。

members.speakLineEn: Drop irrelevant digressions from the intro.
members.speakLineZh: 刪掉導論不相干離題。

members.speakLineEn: Curiosity can leaven a dry methods course.
members.speakLineZh: 好奇心能使乾癟方法課發酵。

members.speakLineEn: A single noisy study is a weak lever for policy.
members.speakLineZh: 單一嘈雜研究是弱政策槓桿。

members.speakLineEn: Elevation of status should follow contribution.
members.speakLineZh: 地位提升應跟隨貢獻。

members.speakLineEn: Public correction brings delayed relief.
members.speakLineZh: 公開勘誤帶來延遲的解脫。

members.speakLineEn: Unrelieved ambiguity belongs in the limits section.
members.speakLineZh: 未減輕的模糊屬於限制段。

clusters.hook: 字根 liber＝自由——檢查哨問：你是真自由，還是浪子自由？
clusters.script: liberate 放人出關；liberty 自由通行證。liberal 寬鬆放行，illiberal 關到更緊。libertine 把自由用成放蕩通行證；libertarian 理論上最小干預。liberalize 法規鬆綁；deliverance 被救出關的劇情——哨兵提醒：自由≠零責任。

members.speakLineEn: Open data can liberate secondary analysis.
members.speakLineZh: 開放資料能解放二次分析。

members.speakLineEn: Academic liberty still needs replication norms.
members.speakLineZh: 學術自由仍需複現規範。

members.zhGloss: 開明的；慷慨的；自由派的
members.senseAnchor: a person who favors a political philosophy of progress and reform and the protection of civil liberties; a person who favors an economic theory of laissez-faire and self-regulating markets
members.speakLineEn: A liberal interpretation still cites the text.
members.speakLineZh: 寬鬆解讀仍要引用文本。

members.speakLineEn: Illiberal gatekeeping blocks critique.
members.speakLineZh: 狹隘把關阻擋批評。

members.speakLineEn: A libertine citation style ignores primary sources.
members.speakLineZh: 放蕩引用風格忽略一手來源。

members.speakLineEn: Libertarian rhetoric can clash with public-good data.
members.speakLineZh: 自由意志修辭可能與公共財資料衝突。

members.speakLineEn: Liberalize access without abandoning ethics review.
members.speakLineZh: 放寬近用但不放棄倫理審查。

members.speakLineEn: Correction can feel like deliverance after years of doubt.
members.speakLineZh: 勘誤在多年懷疑後像解脫。

members.speakLineEn: Method liberation is not method anarchy.
members.speakLineZh: 方法解放不是方法無政府。

members.speakLineEn: Share code freely with clear licenses.
members.speakLineZh: 以清楚授權自由分享程式碼。

members.speakLineEn: Unliberated datasets hide in private drives.
members.speakLineZh: 未解放資料集藏在私人硬碟。

members.speakLineEn: Debate liberalism without turning methods into slogans.
members.speakLineZh: 辯論自由主義，勿把方法變口號。

members.speakLineEn: An eloquent summary still needs citations.
members.speakLineZh: 再雄辯的摘要仍需要引用。

members.senseAnchor: characteristic of informal spoken language or conversation
members.speakLineEn: Colloquial tone can undercut formal claims.
members.speakLineZh: 口語語氣可能削弱正式主張。

members.senseAnchor: speech you make to yourself; a (usually long) dramatic speech intended to give the illusion of unspoken reflections
members.speakLineEn: The chapter reads like a soliloquy, not a dialogue with critics.
members.speakLineZh: 這章讀起來像獨白，而非與批評者對話。

members.speakLineEn: Grandiloquent promises outran the budget.
members.speakLineZh: 誇大承諾超越了預算。

members.speakLineEn: Check the logic before polishing the prose.
members.speakLineZh: 先檢查邏輯，再打磨文筆。

members.speakLineEn: A strained analogy misleads more than it teaches.
members.speakLineZh: 牽強類比誤導多於教學。

members.senseAnchor: a formal expression of praise for someone who has died recently; a formal expression of praise
members.speakLineEn: The eulogy praised method as much as results.
members.speakLineZh: 頌詞對方法與結果同樣稱許。

members.speakLineEn: The prologue frames why the question matters.
members.speakLineZh: 序言框定了問題為何重要。

members.speakLineEn: Loquacity is not the same as clarity.
members.speakLineZh: 話多不等於清楚。

members.senseAnchor: an expert manner of speaking involving control of voice and gesture
members.speakLineEn: Elocution cannot rescue a hollow argument.
members.speakLineZh: 演說技巧救不了空洞論證。

members.speakLineEn: Ideology can script which analogies feel natural.
members.speakLineZh: 意識形態會編排哪些類比顯得自然。

clusters.script: elucidate 闡明照亮；pellucid 清澈透光。translucent 半透明；luminary 發光大人物。luminous 發光的；illuminate 照明。lackluster 無光澤；illustrious 輝煌。

members.senseAnchor: to make clear especially by explanation or analysis
members.speakLineEn: Elucidate the identification assumptions.
members.speakLineZh: 闡明識別假設。

members.speakLineEn: Write a pellucid abstract.
members.speakLineZh: 寫清澈摘要。

members.senseAnchor: allowing light to pass through diffusely
members.speakLineEn: Translucent reporting still hides key exclusions.
members.speakLineZh: 半透明報告仍藏關鍵排除。

members.senseAnchor: a celebrity who is an inspiration to others
members.speakLineEn: Do not defer to luminaries without reading methods.
members.speakLineZh: 別不讀方法就服從名人。

members.speakLineEn: A luminous figure cannot replace a table.
members.speakLineZh: 明亮圖不能取代表格。

members.speakLineEn: Examples illuminate abstract claims.
members.speakLineZh: 例子照亮抽象主張。

members.speakLineEn: Lackluster documentation slows replication.
members.speakLineZh: 平庸文件拖延複現。

members.speakLineEn: Illustrious affiliations do not validate results.
members.speakLineZh: 輝煌單位不驗證結果。

members.speakLineEn: Seek illumination, not applause.
members.speakLineZh: 追求啟發而非掌聲。

members.speakLineEn: Lucidity beats jargon density.
members.speakLineZh: 清晰勝過術語密度。

members.speakLineEn: Relucent metaphors can distract.
members.speakLineZh: 反光隱喻可能分心。

members.speakLineEn: Claim luminescence only with mechanisms.
members.speakLineZh: 有機制才稱發光。

clusters.hook: 字根 man＝手——操作台專管手工、指揮、維修與手冊。
clusters.script: manual／manually 親手操作。manipulate／manipulation 動手腳。manufacture 製造產出。manage／manager／management 指揮手；emancipate 鬆開手銬——台長：manipulate data 零分；manual checks 必要。

members.speakLineEn: Keep a manual for the analysis pipeline.
members.speakLineZh: 為分析管線保留手冊。

members.speakLineEn: Manually audit a random subset of rows.
members.speakLineZh: 手動稽核隨機列子集。

members.speakLineEn: Do not manipulate outcomes after seeing p.
members.speakLineZh: 看到 p 後不要操縱結局。

members.speakLineEn: Outcome manipulation is misconduct.
members.speakLineZh: 結局操縱是不端。

members.speakLineEn: Manage version control like a lab notebook.
members.speakLineZh: 把版本控制當實驗筆記管理。

members.speakLineEn: A manager should model open corrections.
members.speakLineZh: 經理應示範公開勘誤。

members.speakLineEn: Data management plans beat heroics.
members.speakLineZh: 資料管理計畫勝過英雄主義。

members.speakLineEn: A statistical maneuver needs pre-rules.
members.speakLineZh: 統計手法需要預先規則。

members.speakLineEn: Handmade figures still need axis labels.
members.speakLineZh: 手工圖仍需軸標籤。

clusters.hook: 字根 mand＝命令——櫃台專管命令、要求與委託單。
clusters.script: command／commander 下達命令。demand／demanding 強勢要求。mandate／mandatory 強制令。commend 稱讚表現；countermand 撤銷前令——櫃員：mandatory prereg；countermand silent forks。

members.speakLineEn: Command clarity beats charismatic chaos.
members.speakLineZh: 命令清晰勝過魅力混亂。

members.speakLineEn: The analysis commander owns the lock date.
members.speakLineZh: 分析指揮官擁有鎖定日。

members.speakLineEn: Journals demand transparency; labs should too.
members.speakLineZh: 期刊要求透明；實驗室也該如此。

members.speakLineEn: Demanding standards protect readers.
members.speakLineZh: 苛求標準保護讀者。

members.speakLineEn: Mandate open materials in the grant.
members.speakLineZh: 在補助案強制開放材料。

members.speakLineEn: Mandatory checklists catch silent changes.
members.speakLineZh: 強制清單抓住沉默變更。

members.senseAnchor: a contrary command cancelling or reversing a previous command; cancel officially
members.speakLineEn: Countermand any post-hoc outcome swap.
members.speakLineZh: 撤銷任何事後結局替換。

members.senseAnchor: the act of sending an accused person back into custody to await trial (or the continuation of the trial); refer (a matter or legal case) to another committee or authority or court for decision
members.speakLineEn: Remand shaky claims to reanalysis.
members.speakLineZh: 把不穩主張發回重分析。

members.senseAnchor: an act or expression of criticism and censure; rebuke formally
members.speakLineEn: A public reprimand is worse than a quiet fix.
members.speakLineZh: 公開訓斥不如安靜修好。

members.speakLineEn: First commandment: do not peek unblinded.
members.speakLineZh: 第一誡：不要非盲偷看。

members.speakLineEn: File a requisition for compute, not for p.
members.speakLineZh: 申請算力，不是申請 p。

clusters.hook: 字根 mar＝海——風浪館專管海上、水手、潛水與藍色事故。
clusters.script: marine／maritime／mariner 海上編制。submarine 潛下去偷探。marina 停泊碼頭；ultramarine／aquamarine 藍到發亮——館長：submarine peeks 禁止；maritime logs 要留。

members.speakLineEn: Treat multi-site drift like marine currents.
members.speakLineZh: 把多站漂移當海流處理。

members.speakLineEn: Maritime-level documentation survives storms.
members.speakLineZh: 海事級文件撐得過風暴。

members.speakLineEn: No submarine looks at unblinded outcomes.
members.speakLineZh: 禁止潛水偷看非盲結局。

members.speakLineEn: Every mariner of the pipeline signs the log.
members.speakLineZh: 管線上每個水手都簽日誌。

members.speakLineEn: Dock raw data in a read-only marina.
members.speakLineZh: 把原始資料停泊在唯讀碼頭。

members.speakLineEn: Ultramarine claims need ultramarine evidence.
members.speakLineZh: 深藍主張需要深藍證據。

members.speakLineEn: Aquamarine slides still need error bars.
members.speakLineZh: 海藍簡報仍需誤差條。

members.speakLineEn: Seafaring teams need shared maps of decisions.
members.speakLineZh: 航海團隊需要共享決策地圖。

members.speakLineEn: Publish with the tide of the data lock, not hype.
members.speakLineZh: 跟著資料鎖定潮汐發表，不是炒作。

members.senseAnchor: to be strongly connected with a particular system
members.speakLineEn: Anchor claims to a commit hash.
members.speakLineZh: 把主張錨到 commit 雜湊。

members.speakLineEn: A methods shipwreck starts with missing logs.
members.speakLineZh: 方法船難始於缺失日誌。

members.senseAnchor: bright-colored; a float attached by rope to the seabed to mark channels in a harbor or underwater hazards; float on the surface of water
members.speakLineEn: Use buoys: milestones that keep the project afloat.
members.speakLineZh: 用浮標：讓專案浮著的里程碑。

clusters.hook: 字根 mater/matr＝母——登記處管母系、婚姻、母校，還有矩陣媽媽。
clusters.script: maternal／maternity／matron 母性櫃台。matriarch／matriarchal 家族女王。matrimony 結婚登記；alma mater／matrix 母校與矩陣媽媽——登記員：matrix 要可逆；matriarch 也不能免審。

members.speakLineEn: Maternal leave policies need documented coverage.
members.speakLineZh: 產假政策需要文件化覆蓋。

members.speakLineEn: Budget maternity of a project: birth of variables.
members.speakLineZh: 為專案「生產」變數編預算。

members.speakLineEn: Even the lab matriarch accepts corrections.
members.speakLineZh: 實驗室女家長也接受勘誤。

members.speakLineEn: Matriarchal credit rules still need transparency.
members.speakLineZh: 母系功勞規則仍需透明。

members.speakLineEn: A methods matron keeps the codebook tidy.
members.speakLineZh: 方法監護人讓編碼簿整潔。

members.speakLineEn: Code matrimony: merge only with tests.
members.speakLineZh: 程式聯姻：有測試才合併。

members.speakLineEn: Show the confusion matrix, not just accuracy.
members.speakLineZh: 展示混淆矩陣，不只正確率。

members.speakLineEn: Cite your alma mater's open-science rules.
members.speakLineZh: 引用母校的開放科學規則。

members.speakLineEn: The motherlode is raw data with provenance.
members.speakLineZh: 富礦是帶出處的原始資料。

members.speakLineEn: Nurture replications like new litters.
members.speakLineZh: 像養幼崽一樣養育複現。

members.speakLineEn: A brood of related analyses needs a family tree.
members.speakLineZh: 一窩相關分析需要族譜。

members.speakLineEn: Track variable lineage across transforms.
members.speakLineZh: 追蹤變數跨轉換的世系。

clusters.hook: 字根 medi＝中——茶室專管站中間：調解、平庸、中世紀長桌。
clusters.script: mediate／mediation／mediator 勸两边坐下喝茶。mediocre 茶泡得平庸卻硬說是特調。medieval 長桌還在中世紀模式；intermediate／medium 中間档。immediate 沒有中間人——立刻到。remedial 補救課像把人拉回中線重學。

members.speakLineEn: A neutral body can mediate data disputes.
members.speakLineZh: 中立單位可調停資料爭議。

members.speakLineEn: Try mediation before litigation metaphors.
members.speakLineZh: 打官司隱喻前先試調解。

members.speakLineEn: The editor acted as mediator, not advocate.
members.speakLineZh: 編輯當調解人而非辯護人。

members.speakLineEn: Mediocre abstracts bury the contribution.
members.speakLineZh: 平庸摘要埋掉貢獻。

members.speakLineEn: Medieval paywalls block modern collaboration.
members.speakLineZh: 中世紀式付費牆阻擋現代合作。

members.speakLineEn: Report intermediate outcomes transparently.
members.speakLineZh: 透明報告中間結果。

members.speakLineEn: Choose the right medium for preregistration.
members.speakLineZh: 為預註冊選對媒介。

members.speakLineEn: Immediate corrections beat delayed rumors.
members.speakLineZh: 立即勘誤勝過延遲謠言。

members.speakLineEn: Offer remedial stats workshops without stigma.
members.speakLineZh: 提供無汙名的補救統計工作坊。

members.speakLineEn: Avoid opaque intermediaries for raw files.
members.speakLineZh: 原始檔避免不透明中間人。

members.speakLineEn: Prefer the median when outliers shout.
members.speakLineZh: 極端值喊叫時偏好中位數。

members.speakLineEn: Etymology jokes: Mediterranean as 'middle sea'.
members.speakLineZh: 詞源玩笑：地中海＝中間的海。

clusters.hook: 字根 mem＝記——櫃門一開：回憶、紀念、備忘錄全掉出來。
clusters.script: memoir 寫自己的記憶影集；memorable 值得放進櫃。commemorate 公開紀念；memento 小紀念品。immemorial 久到記不起起點；memorabilia 粉絲週邊山。memorandum 辦公室備忘；memorial 紀念碑；mnemonic 記憶口訣貼紙——櫃員說：記得住≠記得對。

members.speakLineEn: A methods memoir should admit dead ends.
members.speakLineZh: 方法回憶錄應承認死路。

members.speakLineEn: A memorable figure still needs a caption.
members.speakLineZh: 難忘的圖仍需圖說。

members.speakLineEn: Commemorate failed trials that taught design.
members.speakLineZh: 紀念教會設計的失敗試驗。

members.speakLineEn: Keep a memento of the first successful audit.
members.speakLineZh: 留一件首次成功稽核的小紀念。

members.senseAnchor: long past; beyond the limits of memory or tradition or recorded history
members.speakLineEn: From time immemorial, labs hoarded notebooks—stop.
members.speakLineZh: 自古以來實驗室囤筆記本——該停。

members.speakLineEn: Conference memorabilia is not a CV method.
members.speakLineZh: 會議週邊不是履歷上的方法。

members.speakLineEn: File a memorandum of every protocol change.
members.speakLineZh: 每次規程變更都備忘。

members.speakLineEn: A digital memorial of retracted claims educates.
members.speakLineZh: 撤稿主張的數位紀念碑能教育。

members.speakLineEn: A mnemonic helps; a checklist verifies.
members.speakLineZh: 口訣幫忙；檢核表驗證。

members.speakLineEn: Remember to report exclusions.
members.speakLineZh: 記得報告排除。

members.speakLineEn: Institutional memory needs version control.
members.speakLineZh: 機構記憶需要版本控管。

members.speakLineEn: A one-line memo cannot replace prereg.
members.speakLineZh: 一行便條不能取代預註冊。

flow.content: memoir 寫自己的記憶影集；memorable 值得放進櫃。commemorate 公開紀念；memento 小紀念品。immemorial 久到記不起起點；memorabilia 粉絲週邊山。memorandum 辦公室備忘；memorial 紀念碑；mnemonic 記憶口訣貼紙——櫃員說：記得住≠記得對。

clusters.hook: 字根 mens/metri＝量——檢驗所專管尺寸、公尺與『巨大』廣告。
clusters.script: measure／measurement／measurable 先能量。metric／meter 公尺與指標。immense／immensity 大到尺不夠。commensurate 成比例對齊——所長：metric 要 operational；immense claim 要 immense evidence。

members.speakLineEn: Measure what you claim.
members.speakLineZh: 測量你所主張的。

members.speakLineEn: Bad measurement sinks causal talk.
members.speakLineZh: 糟糕測量讓因果空談沉沒。

members.speakLineEn: Prefer measurable endpoints.
members.speakLineZh: 偏好可測量終點。

members.speakLineEn: Declare the primary metric in advance.
members.speakLineZh: 事先聲明主要指標。

members.speakLineEn: Calibrate the meter before comparing labs.
members.speakLineZh: 比較實驗室前先校正計量器。

members.speakLineEn: Immense claims need immense checks.
members.speakLineZh: 巨大主張需要巨大檢查。

members.speakLineEn: The immensity of the literature is not an excuse for thin methods.
members.speakLineZh: 文獻巨大不是方法單薄的藉口。

members.senseAnchor: corresponding in size or degree or extent
members.speakLineEn: Rewards should be commensurate with contribution.
members.speakLineZh: 報酬應與貢獻相稱。

members.speakLineEn: State the dimension you generalize to.
members.speakLineZh: 說明你概括到的維度。

members.speakLineEn: Check scale invariance claims carefully.
members.speakLineZh: 仔細檢查尺度不變宣稱。

members.speakLineEn: Gigantic dashboards can hide missingness.
members.speakLineZh: 巨大儀表板可能藏缺失。

members.speakLineEn: Tiny effects still deserve intervals.
members.speakLineZh: 微小效應仍值得區間。

clusters.hook: 字根 merc＝商／報——商會裡有商人、商品，也有只為錢打仗的傭兵。
clusters.script: merchant／merchandise／mercantile／commerce／commercial 買賣大廳。mercenary 只認錢的刀。mercy／merciful 法外開恩櫃；mercury 滑溜信使——會長：commercial incentives 要揭露；mercenary stats 滾出去。

members.speakLineEn: Be a merchant of methods, not of miracles.
members.speakLineZh: 做方法商人，不是奇蹟商人。

members.speakLineEn: Do not merchandise p-values as products.
members.speakLineZh: 別把 p 值當商品販售。

members.speakLineEn: Mercantile pressure can distort endpoints.
members.speakLineZh: 商業壓力會扭曲終點。

members.speakLineEn: Open science is commerce of scrutiny.
members.speakLineZh: 開放科學是審視的交易。

members.speakLineEn: Disclose commercial ties in the paper.
members.speakLineZh: 在論文揭露商業關係。

members.speakLineEn: Mercenary analytic choices chase headlines.
members.speakLineZh: 唯利分析選擇追逐標題。

members.speakLineEn: Show no mercy to fabricated rows.
members.speakLineZh: 對捏造列不開恩。

members.speakLineEn: Be merciful to honest mistakes, harsh to cover-ups.
members.speakLineZh: 對誠實錯誤慈悲，對掩蓋嚴厲。

members.speakLineEn: Mercury-fast releases still need audits.
members.speakLineZh: 水銀般快速發布仍需稽核。

members.speakLineEn: A bargain with bias is never cheap.
members.speakLineZh: 與偏差討價還價從不便宜。

members.speakLineEn: Invoice compute costs honestly in grants.
members.speakLineZh: 在補助案誠實開列計算成本。

members.speakLineEn: State the scientific payoff before the press.
members.speakLineZh: 新聞前先說科學報酬。

clusters.hook: 字根 merge/mers＝沉——泳池專管沉下去、浮出來、泡進去。
clusters.script: submerge 整個人沉下去；emerge 冒出頭喘气。immerse 泡進水裡學仰式。emergency 緊急出水警報；merger 兩池併成一池——救生員：資料可以 immerse，結論別 submerge 不利結果。

members.speakLineEn: Do not submerge adverse findings in appendices.
members.speakLineZh: 不要把不良發現沉進附錄。

members.speakLineEn: Patterns emerge only after cleaning logs.
members.speakLineZh: 清理日誌後模式才浮現。

members.senseAnchor: thrust or throw into; devote (oneself) fully to
members.speakLineEn: Immerse students in real messy datasets.
members.speakLineZh: 讓學生沉浸真實凌亂資料。

members.speakLineEn: Have an emergency plan for data leaks.
members.speakLineZh: 為資料洩漏準備緊急計畫。

members.speakLineEn: A journal merger should not erase archives.
members.speakLineZh: 期刊合併不該抹掉檔案。

members.speakLineEn: The emergence of open norms took a decade.
members.speakLineZh: 開放規範的興起花了十年。

members.speakLineEn: Submergence of dissent harms labs.
members.speakLineZh: 異議沉沒傷害實驗室。

members.speakLineEn: Immersive training beats slide-only ethics.
members.speakLineZh: 沉浸式訓練勝過只放投影片的倫理課。

members.speakLineEn: Old bugs reemerge without tests.
members.speakLineZh: 沒有測試舊錯誤會再冒出。

members.speakLineEn: Demerge entangled hypotheses before testing.
members.speakLineZh: 檢驗前先拆開糾纏假說。

members.speakLineEn: Weak identification will sink causal talk.
members.speakLineZh: 弱識別會讓因果空談下沉。

members.speakLineEn: Keep the project afloat with honest timelines.
members.speakLineZh: 用誠實時程讓專案漂浮。

clusters.hook: 字根 migr＝移——口岸專管遷移、移民與轉場。
clusters.script: migrate／migration 資料搬家。immigrant／emigrant 進關／出關人。migratory 季節性遷徙。transmigrate 轉世梗搬場——關員：migrate pipelines 要有 checksum；別 migrate 結局定義。

members.speakLineEn: Treat immigrant datasets with local consent rules.
members.speakLineZh: 移入資料集遵守在地同意規則。

members.speakLineEn: Emigrant variables need destination labels.
members.speakLineZh: 移出變數需要目的地標籤。

members.speakLineEn: Relocating servers is not relocating outcomes.
members.speakLineZh: 搬伺服器不是搬結局。

members.senseAnchor: a journey by a large group to escape from a hostile environment; the second book of the Old Testament: tells of the departure of the Israelites out of slavery in Egypt led by Moses; God gave them the Ten Commandments and the rest of Mosaic law on Mount Sinai during the Exodus
members.speakLineEn: An exodus of staff risks lost documentation.
members.speakLineZh: 人員大出走有文件遺失風險。

members.speakLineEn: Nomad analysts still commit to a repo.
members.speakLineZh: 遊牧分析師仍要提交到 repo。

members.speakLineEn: Keep identifiers in transit encrypted.
members.speakLineZh: 過境中的識別碼要加密。

members.speakLineEn: Uproot legacy scripts that hide peeks.
members.speakLineZh: 拔起隱藏偷看的遺留腳本。

members.speakLineEn: Resettle cleaned data in a read-only vault.
members.speakLineZh: 把清乾淨資料再安家到唯讀庫。

clusters.hook: 字根 mir＝奇、看——鏡屋專管驚奇、鏡子與奇蹟廣告。
clusters.script: miracle／miraculous 奇蹟燈箱（廣告勿信）。mirror 鏡子複現。admire／admiration 欣賞反光。mirage 沙漠假水——導遊：admire 好複現；mirage 的『顯著』請離開。
pitfalls: miracle 不應用於未複現發現

members.speakLineEn: A single study is not a miracle.
members.speakLineZh: 單一研究不是奇蹟。

members.speakLineEn: Miraculous effect sizes need skepticism.
members.speakLineZh: 奇蹟般效應量需要懷疑。

members.speakLineEn: Independent labs should mirror the protocol.
members.speakLineZh: 獨立實驗室應鏡像規程。

members.speakLineEn: Admire careful null reporting.
members.speakLineZh: 欣賞謹慎的虛無報告。

members.speakLineEn: Save admiration for transparent corrections.
members.speakLineZh: 把欽佩留給透明勘誤。

members.senseAnchor: an optical illusion in which atmospheric refraction by a layer of hot air distorts or inverts reflections of distant objects; something illusory and unattainable
members.speakLineEn: A mirage of certainty fades under audit.
members.speakLineZh: 確定性的海市蜃樓在稽核下消散。

members.speakLineEn: A mirror-image replication still needs local ethics.
members.speakLineZh: 鏡像複現仍需在地倫理。

members.senseAnchor: one that evokes surprise, admiration or wonder
members.speakLineEn: Marvel less; measure more.
members.speakLineZh: 少驚嘆；多測量。

members.speakLineEn: Wonder aloud about missing cells.
members.speakLineZh: 大聲好奇缺失格子。

members.speakLineEn: Reflect exclusions in the flowchart.
members.speakLineZh: 在流程圖反映排除。

members.speakLineEn: Significance stars can be an illusion of importance.
members.speakLineZh: 顯著星號可能是重要錯覺。

clusters.hook: 字根 mit/miss＝送、放——一切都是快遞單。
clusters.script: 信號 transmit 送出去；員工被 dismiss 送走。責任 remiss 是該送卻沒送到；密使是 emissary。permit 放行，submit 呈送上去，intermittent 送一下停一下。mission 是被派出去的任務，missile 是被送出去的武器。
reviewHooks: mit＝送：transmit 傳送、dismiss 打發走、submit 呈上、permit 放行
remiss＝該做沒做（快遞丟件）；intermittent＝斷斷續續送
pitfalls: emit（發出）與 omit（省略）只差一字母——本族先主打 mit/miss 派遣義
dismiss 可指解雇或『不予考慮』

members.speakLineEn: Rumors transmit faster than corrections.
members.speakLineZh: 謠言比澄清傳得更快。

members.speakLineEn: Do not dismiss anomalous data too quickly.
members.speakLineZh: 不要太快把異常資料打發掉。

members.speakLineEn: It would be remiss to ignore conflicting studies.
members.speakLineZh: 忽略互相衝突的研究會是疏忽。

members.senseAnchor: someone sent on a mission to represent the interests of someone else
members.speakLineEn: An emissary carried the compromise proposal.
members.speakLineZh: 一名密使帶著妥協方案。

members.speakLineEn: The design does not permit causal claims.
members.speakLineZh: 該設計不允許做出因果宣稱。

members.speakLineEn: Authors must submit raw data upon request.
members.speakLineZh: 作者必須在要求時提交原始資料。

members.senseAnchor: coming and going at intervals, not continuous
members.speakLineEn: Intermittent funding stalled the longitudinal design.
members.speakLineZh: 斷續經費讓縱貫設計停擺。

members.speakLineEn: The mission of the review is synthesis, not discovery.
members.speakLineZh: 該評論的使命是綜整，不是發現。

members.senseAnchor: a written message addressed to a person or organization
members.speakLineEn: A terse missive ended the collaboration.
members.speakLineZh: 一封簡短書信結束了合作。

members.speakLineEn: Only admissible evidence should shape the verdict.
members.speakLineZh: 只有可採納證據才應影響裁決。

members.speakLineEn: The omission of a control group weakens inference.
members.speakLineZh: 遺漏對照組削弱了推論。

clusters.hook: 字根 mon/monit＝警告、提醒——廣播站專管提前提醒與召喚。
clusters.script: admonish／admonition 廣播訓誡。monitor 螢幕監看；monitory 警告語氣。premonition 不祥預告片；summon 召喚到站。monument 用石頭警告後人「別重蹈」——DJ 說：premonition 不是證據，admonish 要對事。

members.senseAnchor: admonish or counsel in terms of someone's behavior; warn strongly; put on guard
members.speakLineEn: Admonish silent exclusions in review.
members.speakLineZh: 在審查中告誡沉默排除。

members.speakLineEn: Take the admonition about power seriously.
members.speakLineZh: 認真對待關於檢定力的訓誡。

members.speakLineEn: Monitor drift in coding reliability.
members.speakLineZh: 監視編碼信度漂移。

members.speakLineEn: A monitory footnote is kinder than a scandal.
members.speakLineZh: 警告腳註比醜聞仁慈。

members.senseAnchor: a feeling of evil to come; an early warning about a future event
members.speakLineEn: A premonition of bias still needs a test.
members.speakLineZh: 偏差預感仍需檢驗。

members.senseAnchor: call in an official matter, such as to attend court; ask to come
members.speakLineEn: Summon an independent auditor early.
members.speakLineZh: 及早召喚獨立稽核。

members.speakLineEn: Make the correction a monument, not a whisper.
members.speakLineZh: 讓勘誤成紀念碑而非耳語。

members.senseAnchor: relating or belonging to or serving as a monument; of outstanding significance
members.speakLineEn: A monumental error needs a monumental fix.
members.speakLineZh: 巨大錯誤需要巨大修復。

members.speakLineEn: Ethics boards can issue a figurative summons.
members.speakLineZh: 倫理委員會可發比喻式傳喚。

members.speakLineEn: Early warnings beat late retractions.
members.speakLineZh: 早期警告勝過晚期撤稿。

members.speakLineEn: Calendar reminders for registry updates help.
members.speakLineZh: 登錄更新的日曆提醒有幫助。

members.speakLineEn: Fund independent watchdogs for data integrity.
members.speakLineZh: 資助獨立監察者守護資料誠信。

clusters.hook: 字根 morph＝形——舞台燈光一轉，形狀整容直播。
clusters.script: amorphous 還沒定妝，一團糊。metamorphosis 整隻蝴蝶級變身；morph 動詞瞬變。anthropomorphic 把資料擬人成會說話的角色；polymorphous／isomorphic 多形或同形對照。morphology 專管字形／形態學——主持人警告：變裝可以，偷換結局變項不行。

members.speakLineEn: An amorphous hypothesis cannot be tested.
members.speakLineZh: 無定形假說無法檢驗。

members.speakLineEn: The field's metamorphosis toward open methods is slow.
members.speakLineZh: 領域朝開放方法的蛻變很慢。

members.speakLineEn: Do not morph outcomes after seeing results.
members.speakLineZh: 看到結果後不要瞬變結局變項。

members.speakLineEn: Avoid anthropomorphic claims about algorithms' 'intent'.
members.speakLineZh: 避免說演算法有「意圖」的擬人主張。

members.speakLineEn: Polymorphous constructs need clear operationalization.
members.speakLineZh: 多形構念需要清楚操作化。

members.speakLineEn: Isomorphic models still differ in assumptions.
members.speakLineZh: 同構模型假設仍可能不同。

members.speakLineEn: Morphology of words aids humor mnemonics.
members.speakLineZh: 構詞形態學幫助幽默記憶。

members.speakLineEn: Metamorphic change in norms needs leadership.
members.speakLineZh: 規範的變質式改變需要領導。

members.speakLineEn: Silent morphing of code is misconduct-adjacent.
members.speakLineZh: 沉默變臉改碼近乎不端。

members.speakLineEn: Shapeless aims produce shapeless papers.
members.speakLineZh: 無形目標產出無形論文。

members.speakLineEn: Formless 'innovation' talk skips measurement.
members.speakLineZh: 無形式「創新」空談跳過測量。

members.speakLineEn: Be a transformer of habits, not of p-values.
members.speakLineZh: 做習慣變形者，不是 p 值變形者。

flow.content: 字根 morph＝形——舞台燈光一轉，形狀整容直播。

flow.name: 串記劇本
flow.content: amorphous 還沒定妝，一團糊。metamorphosis 整隻蝴蝶級變身；morph 動詞瞬變。anthropomorphic 把資料擬人成會說話的角色；polymorphous／isomorphic 多形或同形對照。morphology 專管字形／形態學——主持人警告：變裝可以，偷換結局變項不行。

flow.content: 義錨 → 角色 → 跟讀英／中

flow.name: 快測
flow.content: quiz ×3

clusters.hook: 字根 mort＝死——登記處專管終點與瀕死。
clusters.script: mortal／mortality 會死與死亡率。immortal 不死。mortify 使羞愧欲死；moribund 瀕死。mortgage 抵押（把未來押死）；postmortem 事後檢討；mortuary 停屍間。
pitfalls: mortify 常＝使羞愧，不只「殺死」

members.speakLineEn: Even famous theories are mortal.
members.speakLineZh: 即使著名理論也會死。

members.speakLineEn: No dataset is immortal without curation.
members.speakLineZh: 沒有策展就沒有不朽資料集。

members.senseAnchor: the quality or state of being mortal; the ratio of deaths in an area to the population of that area; expressed per 1000 per year
members.speakLineEn: Report mortality with risk intervals.
members.speakLineZh: 報告死亡率請帶風險區間。

members.senseAnchor: practice self-denial of one's body and appetites; hold within limits and control
members.speakLineEn: Errors should mortify ego, not hide.
members.speakLineZh: 錯誤應讓自我羞愧，而非隱藏。

members.senseAnchor: not growing or changing; without force or vitality; being on the point of death; breathing your last
members.speakLineEn: A moribund journal still holds archives.
members.speakLineZh: 瀕死期刊仍有檔案。

members.senseAnchor: a conditional conveyance of property as security for the repayment of a loan; put up as security or collateral
members.speakLineEn: Do not mortgage rigor for speed.
members.speakLineZh: 不要為速度抵押嚴謹。

members.speakLineEn: Run a blameless postmortem on the failed launch.
members.speakLineZh: 對失敗上線做無責事後檢討。

members.speakLineEn: Treat retracted papers like a methods mortuary—learn, don't gossip.
members.speakLineZh: 把撤稿當方法停屍間：學習勿八卦。

members.speakLineEn: Seek immortality of methods, not of egos.
members.speakLineZh: 追求方法不朽而非自我不朽。

members.speakLineEn: An editor can play mortician for dead claims.
members.speakLineZh: 編輯可為死主張扮演殯葬者。

members.speakLineEn: A failed replication can be a deathblow to hype.
members.speakLineZh: 失敗複現可成炒作致命一擊。

members.speakLineEn: Avoid rigor mortis in outdated protocols.
members.speakLineZh: 避免過時規程像屍僵。

flow.content: quiz ×3

clusters.hook: 字根 mot/mov＝動——傳動軸專管誰在動、為何動。
clusters.script: motive／motivation 為何而動；emotion 心被帶動。promote 往前推升，demote 往下挪。remote 離得遠；locomotion 移動方式。commotion 一陣騷動；motile 能自己動。immutable 動不了改不了；mobilize 動員起來；momentous 一動就影響重大。
pitfalls: motive（動機）≠ motif（主題動機／圖案）

members.speakLineEn: State the motive for excluding outliers.
members.speakLineZh: 說明排除極端值的動機。

members.speakLineEn: Intrinsic motivation beats punitive grading.
members.speakLineZh: 內在動機勝過懲罰式評分。

members.speakLineEn: Emotion can bias risk perception.
members.speakLineZh: 情緒可能扭曲風險知覺。

members.speakLineEn: Open methods promote cumulative trust.
members.speakLineZh: 開放方法促進累積信任。

members.speakLineEn: A failed audit can demote a preferred model.
members.speakLineZh: 失敗稽核可把偏好模型降級。

members.speakLineEn: Remote sensing still needs ground truth.
members.speakLineZh: 遙感仍需地面實況。

members.speakLineEn: Measure locomotion errors in the robot trial.
members.speakLineZh: 量測機器人試驗的移動誤差。

members.speakLineEn: Online commotion is not evidence of effect size.
members.speakLineZh: 網路騷動不是效應量證據。

members.senseAnchor: one whose prevailing mental imagery takes the form of inner feelings of action; (of spores or microorganisms) capable of movement
members.speakLineEn: Motile cells complicate fixed imaging.
members.speakLineZh: 能動細胞讓固定成像變複雜。

members.speakLineEn: Treat timestamps as immutable once logged.
members.speakLineZh: 時間戳一經記錄即不可改。

members.speakLineEn: Mobilize reviewers early for adversarial checks.
members.speakLineZh: 及早動員審稿人做對抗檢查。

members.speakLineEn: A momentous protocol change needs versioning.
members.speakLineZh: 重大規程變更需要版本控管。

flow.content: quiz ×3

clusters.hook: 字根 mut＝變——交換所專管突變、互換、互相。
clusters.script: mutate／mutation 基因櫃突然變樣；mutable 還改得動，對面是 immutable（他族已登場）。commute 上下班交換路線；mutual 互相交換好處。transmute 煉金式質變；permutation 排列交換秀——櫃員章：先登記再突變。
pitfalls: commute 可＝通勤或減刑／互換

members.speakLineEn: Estimates mutate when you silent-swap covariates.
members.speakLineZh: 沉默替換共變項時估計會突變。

members.speakLineEn: Treat protocol mutation as a logged event.
members.speakLineZh: 把規程突變當需記錄事件。

members.speakLineEn: Keep inclusion rules mutable only before lock.
members.speakLineZh: 納入規則僅鎖定前可改。

members.speakLineEn: Do not commute a strong claim into a weak one quietly.
members.speakLineZh: 不要悄悄把強主張換成弱主張。

members.speakLineEn: Mutual transparency builds consortia.
members.speakLineZh: 相互透明建立聯盟。

members.senseAnchor: change in outward structure or looks; change or alter in form, appearance, or nature
members.speakLineEn: Hype cannot transmute correlation into causation.
members.speakLineZh: 炒作不能把相關煉成因果。

members.speakLineEn: Multiple testing across permutations needs correction.
members.speakLineZh: 跨排列的多重檢定需要校正。

members.speakLineEn: Declare mutability of analysis plans up front.
members.speakLineZh: 事先聲明分析計畫可變性。

members.speakLineEn: Order commutativity fails for some filters.
members.speakLineZh: 某些濾波不滿足交換律。

members.speakLineEn: A mutant metric needs a new validation.
members.speakLineZh: 突變指標需要新驗證。

members.speakLineEn: Exchange drafts before public claims.
members.speakLineZh: 公開主張前先交換草稿。

members.speakLineEn: Interchange train/test only with leakage checks.
members.speakLineZh: 對調訓練／測試須防洩漏。

flow.name: 快測
flow.content: quiz ×3

clusters.hook: 字根 nasc/nat＝生——產房專管天生、國家、自然與新生。
clusters.script: native／nativity 土生與誕生。nature／natural／naturalistic 自然產線。nation／national／international 國界標籤。nascent 剛出生的計畫；innate 天生氣質——護士：nascent ideas 要養；假 natural 結論要查。

members.speakLineEn: Prefer native file formats over screenshots.
members.speakLineZh: 寧可原生檔格式，不要截圖。

members.speakLineEn: Record the nativity of each derived variable.
members.speakLineZh: 記錄每個派生變數的誕生。

members.speakLineEn: State the nature of the estimand clearly.
members.speakLineZh: 清楚陳述目標量本質。

members.speakLineEn: Natural experiments still need assumptions.
members.speakLineZh: 自然實驗仍需假設。

members.speakLineEn: Naturalistic observation is not causal ID.
members.speakLineZh: 自然主義觀察不是因果識別。

members.speakLineEn: Nation-level aggregates hide local bias.
members.speakLineZh: 國家層加總掩蓋地方偏差。

members.speakLineEn: National registries need access protocols.
members.speakLineZh: 國家登錄庫需要存取規程。

members.speakLineEn: International teams still share one codebook.
members.speakLineZh: 國際團隊仍共用一本編碼簿。

members.speakLineEn: Do prenatal design reviews before funding.
members.speakLineZh: 補助前先做產前設計審查。

members.speakLineEn: A methods renaissance starts with open logs.
members.speakLineZh: 方法復興從開放日誌開始。

clusters.hook: 字根 nav＝船——調度室管海軍、導航、繞地球一圈，還有暈船。
clusters.script: navy／naval 艦隊編制。navigate／navigation／navigator／nautical 航海圖與舵手。circumnavigate 繞一圈；astronaut／nausea 太空人與暈船袋——調度：navigate uncertainty；別 circumnavigate 審查。

members.speakLineEn: Keep a navy of unit tests around the pipeline.
members.speakLineZh: 在管線外圍部署單元測試艦隊。

members.speakLineEn: Naval discipline: commit messages with cargo lists.
members.speakLineZh: 海軍紀律：commit 訊息附貨物清單。

members.speakLineEn: Navigate trade-offs explicitly in the paper.
members.speakLineZh: 在論文明確導航權衡。

members.speakLineEn: Provide navigation for readers through supplements.
members.speakLineZh: 為讀者提供補充材料航圖。

members.speakLineEn: Appoint a reproducibility navigator.
members.speakLineZh: 指定一位可複現舵手。

members.senseAnchor: relating to or involving ships or shipping or navigation or seamen
members.speakLineEn: Nautical charts beat oral folklore.
members.speakLineZh: 航海圖勝過口頭傳說。

members.speakLineEn: Do not circumnavigate peer review with preprints only.
members.speakLineZh: 別只用預印本繞開同儕審查。

members.speakLineEn: Be an astronaut of edge cases in staging.
members.speakLineZh: 在測試環境當邊界案例太空人。

members.senseAnchor: the state that precedes vomiting; disgust so strong it makes you feel sick
members.speakLineEn: P-hacking should induce methodological nausea.
members.speakLineZh: p 值黑客應引起方法噁心感。

members.speakLineEn: Let the protocol be your compass.
members.speakLineZh: 讓規程當你的羅盤。

members.senseAnchor: a hinged vertical airfoil mounted at the tail of an aircraft and used to make horizontal course changes; (nautical) steering mechanism consisting of a hinged vertical plate mounted at the stern of a vessel
members.speakLineEn: Preregistration is the rudder under windy hype.
members.speakLineZh: 預註冊是炒作風中的舵。

members.speakLineEn: A flotilla of robustness checks escorts the claim.
members.speakLineZh: 穩健檢查小艦隊護送主張。

flow.content: quiz ×3

clusters.hook: 字根 neg＝否——開關室專管「關掉／否認」。
clusters.script: negate 直接否定；abnegate 自我否定放棄。renegade 背叛原陣營。negligent／negligible：疏忽 vs 可忽略的小量。renege 食言反悔；denigrate 抹黑貶低。negotiation 討價還價像半否定半妥協；negative 負面開關。
reviewHooks: negligent 疏忽 ≠ negligible 可忽略
pitfalls: negligent（疏忽的人／行為）≠ negligible（小到可忽略）

members.speakLineEn: One confound can negate the causal claim.
members.speakLineZh: 一個混淆變項能否掉因果主張。

members.senseAnchor: deny oneself (something); restrain, especially from indulging in some pleasure; surrender (power or a position)
members.speakLineEn: Leaders who abnegate credit build stronger teams.
members.speakLineZh: 放棄邀功的領導者能建更強團隊。

members.senseAnchor: one who rejects a religion, cause, allegiance, or group for another
members.speakLineEn: A renegade analyst published the null result.
members.speakLineZh: 變節分析者發表了虛無結果。

members.senseAnchor: failing to give proper attention or care
members.speakLineEn: Negligent storage of identifiers is a breach.
members.speakLineZh: 識別資料疏忽儲存即違規。

members.speakLineEn: The bias was negligible under sensitivity checks.
members.speakLineZh: 敏感度檢查下偏差可忽略。

members.senseAnchor: the mistake of not following suit when able to do so; fail to fulfill a promise or obligation
members.speakLineEn: Do not renege on data-sharing pledges.
members.speakLineZh: 不要對資料共享承諾食言。

members.senseAnchor: cause to seem less serious; play down; charge falsely or with malicious intent; attack the good name and reputation of someone
members.speakLineEn: Do not denigrate qualitative work as soft.
members.speakLineZh: 不要把質性工作抹黑成「軟」。

members.speakLineEn: A negative finding still updates beliefs.
members.speakLineZh: 陰性發現仍更新信念。

members.speakLineEn: Methodological abnegation means dropping pet theories.
members.speakLineZh: 方法論克己意味放下寵物理論。

members.speakLineEn: Renegotiate authorship when roles change mid-project.
members.speakLineZh: 角色中途改變時重談作者權。

members.senseAnchor: a negative statement; a statement that is a refusal or denial of some other statement; the speech act of negating
members.speakLineEn: Logical negation flips the claim's truth value.
members.speakLineZh: 邏輯否定翻轉命題真值。

members.speakLineEn: Self-abnegation can hide coercive lab cultures.
members.speakLineZh: 過度克己可能掩蓋強制實驗室文化。

content: negligent 疏忽 ≠ negligible 可忽略

clusters.hook: 字根 noc/nox＝害——管制局門口寫：無辜／有罪／夜間加班都可能『有害』。
clusters.script: innocent 自稱無害通行證。noxious／obnoxious 毒氣與討人厭同事。innocuous 看起來無害其實要驗。noxious fumes 從附錄冒出；innocence 被審核追問——局長章：innocuous 寫作可以，noxious 誘因不行；obnoxious 語氣零分。

members.speakLineEn: An innocent typo is not research misconduct.
members.speakLineZh: 無辜打字錯誤不是研究不端。

members.speakLineEn: An innocuous footnote can still hide a swap.
members.speakLineZh: 無害腳註仍可能藏替換。

members.senseAnchor: causing intense displeasure, disgust, or resentment
members.speakLineEn: Noxious incentives reward flashy false positives.
members.speakLineZh: 有害誘因獎勵炫目假陽性。

members.speakLineEn: Presume innocence, then audit the logs.
members.speakLineZh: 先假定清白，再稽核日誌。

members.speakLineEn: Measure the noxiousness of paywalled data.
members.speakLineZh: 測量付費牆資料的有害性。

members.speakLineEn: Harmless metaphors can still mislead.
members.speakLineZh: 無害隱喻仍可能誤導。

members.speakLineEn: Toxic lab culture blocks error reports.
members.speakLineZh: 有毒實驗室文化阻擋錯誤回報。

members.speakLineEn: A nuisance bug still needs a ticket.
members.speakLineZh: 滋擾級錯誤仍需開單。

members.senseAnchor: make impure; make radioactive by adding radioactive material
members.speakLineEn: Do not contaminate the analysis with peeks.
members.speakLineZh: 不要用偷看污染分析。

members.speakLineEn: Publication poison is silent outcome switching.
members.speakLineZh: 發表毒藥是沉默更換結局。

members.senseAnchor: a remedy that stops or controls the effects of a poison
members.speakLineEn: Preregistration is an antidote to fishing.
members.speakLineZh: 預註冊是淘篩解毒劑。

flow.name: 快測
flow.content: quiz ×3

clusters.hook: 字根 nov＝新——發表會專管新東西與新手。
clusters.script: novel／novelty 新奇。innovate／innovation 創新。renovate 翻新；novice 新手。innovative 創新的；nova 新星。
reviewHooks: novelty 嗜好可能排擠複現
pitfalls: novel 可作形容詞「新的」或名詞「小說」

members.speakLineEn: A novel measure needs validation.
members.speakLineZh: 新測量需要驗證。

members.speakLineEn: Novelty bias crowds out replication.
members.speakLineZh: 新奇偏差排擠複現。

members.speakLineEn: Innovate on sharing tools, not on hiding exclusions.
members.speakLineZh: 在共享工具上創新，而非隱藏排除。

members.speakLineEn: Process innovation can cut error rates.
members.speakLineZh: 流程創新能降低錯誤率。

members.senseAnchor: restore to a previous or better condition; make brighter and prettier
members.speakLineEn: Renovate legacy code before scaling.
members.speakLineZh: 擴張前先翻新舊程式碼。

members.speakLineEn: Novice analysts need checklists.
members.speakLineZh: 新手分析者需要檢核表。

members.speakLineEn: Innovative visualization still needs axes labeled.
members.speakLineZh: 創新視覺化仍需標軸。

members.speakLineEn: A media nova faded after critique.
members.speakLineZh: 媒體新星在批評後黯淡。

members.speakLineEn: Treat the first year as a novitiate in ethics.
members.speakLineZh: 把第一年當倫理見習期。

members.speakLineEn: Nouveau metrics need skeptical adoption.
members.speakLineZh: 新派指標需懷疑地採用。

members.speakLineEn: Renew consent when protocols change.
members.speakLineZh: 規程變更時更新同意。

members.senseAnchor: the conversion of wasteland into land suitable for use of habitation or cultivation; the act of renewing
members.speakLineEn: License renewal triggered an audit.
members.speakLineZh: 授權更新觸發稽核。

flow.content: novel／novelty 新奇。innovate／innovation 創新。renovate 翻新；novice 新手。innovative 創新的；nova 新星。

clusters.hook: 字根 numer＝數——清算櫃把數字排好，也抓「數不清」的誇大。
clusters.script: numeral／numerator／numerous／innumerable 數字柜台。enumerate／enumeration 逐一點名。supernumerary 編制外多餘；numerology 把數字當玄學——櫃員：enumerate exclusions；拒 numerology 式解讀。

members.speakLineEn: Define the numeral coding before collection.
members.speakLineZh: 收集前定義數字編碼。

members.speakLineEn: Numerous robustness checks beat one lucky p.
members.speakLineZh: 許多穩健檢查勝過一個幸運 p。

members.speakLineEn: Enumerate every exclusion with counts.
members.speakLineZh: 列舉每次排除並附計數。

members.speakLineEn: Publish the enumeration of deviations.
members.speakLineZh: 公開偏離的清點表。

members.speakLineEn: Innumerable post-hoc tweaks destroy credibility.
members.speakLineZh: 無數事後微調摧毀可信度。

members.speakLineEn: Keep the numerator definition locked.
members.speakLineZh: 鎖定分子定義。

members.speakLineEn: Cut supernumerary outcomes early.
members.speakLineZh: 及早砍掉多餘結局。

members.speakLineEn: Do not practice p-value numerology.
members.speakLineZh: 不要搞 p 值數字命理。

members.senseAnchor: a score in baseball made by a runner touching all four bases safely; a bill for an amount due
members.speakLineEn: Tally decisions in a living protocol.
members.speakLineZh: 在活的規程裡記分決策。

members.speakLineEn: Run a census of variables before modeling.
members.speakLineZh: 建模前做變數普查。

members.speakLineEn: Report headcount at each exclusion step.
members.speakLineZh: 每步排除報告人頭數。

members.speakLineEn: Show the arithmetic behind composite scores.
members.speakLineZh: 展示複合分數背後的算術。

clusters.hook: 字根 nym/nomen＝名——更衣室專管掛什麼名牌。
clusters.script: anonymous 不掛名；pseudonym 掛假名。synonym 同義名牌，antonym 反義名牌。misnomer 叫錯名；ignominy 臭名。nominal 名義上的；renown 大名。nomenclature 整套命名系統；homonym 同音異義的撞名。
pitfalls: misnomer＝名稱不當，不是「失誤」泛稱

members.speakLineEn: Anonymous review can reduce status bias.
members.speakLineZh: 匿名審查可降低地位偏差。

members.speakLineEn: She published under a pseudonym to avoid retaliation.
members.speakLineZh: 她用筆名發表以免報復。

members.speakLineEn: A near synonym still shifts tone.
members.speakLineZh: 近義詞仍會改語氣。

members.speakLineEn: List the antonym to test if you grasp the scale.
members.speakLineZh: 列出反義詞以檢驗是否掌握尺度。

members.senseAnchor: a wrong use of a name
members.speakLineEn: Calling it a 'pilot' was a misnomer for a full trial.
members.speakLineZh: 稱為試點其實是完整試驗的誤稱。

members.speakLineEn: Fraud brings lasting ignominy to a lab.
members.speakLineZh: 造假給實驗室帶來長久恥辱。

members.senseAnchor: a phrase that can function as the subject or object of a verb; relating to or constituting or bearing or giving a name
members.speakLineEn: Nominal authorship without contribution is unethical.
members.speakLineZh: 無貢獻的掛名作者不倫理。

members.senseAnchor: the state or quality of being widely honored and acclaimed
members.speakLineEn: Renown should not exempt anyone from audit.
members.speakLineZh: 名望不該豁免稽核。

members.speakLineEn: Clarify nomenclature before coding categories.
members.speakLineZh: 編碼類別前先釐清命名。

members.speakLineEn: Homonyms confuse automated text classifiers.
members.speakLineZh: 同形異義詞困擾自動分類器。

members.speakLineEn: Define every acronym at first use.
members.speakLineZh: 每個縮寫首次出現要定義。

members.speakLineEn: Anonymity is hard once raw audio exists.
members.speakLineZh: 有原始音檔時匿名很難。

clusters.hook: 字根 oper＝工作——指揮台把「動手做」編成歌劇級流程。
clusters.script: operate／operation／operator／operative 開機作業。cooperate／cooperation 合奏席。opera／operatic／opus 把工作唱成劇；inoperative／operable 故障燈與可修標——台長：operative definition 要寫；inoperative ethics 禁演。

members.speakLineEn: Operate only on locked analysis code.
members.speakLineZh: 只在鎖定分析程式上操作。

members.speakLineEn: Document every operation that changes outcomes.
members.speakLineZh: 記錄每次改結局的操作。

members.speakLineEn: The pipeline operator owns the changelog.
members.speakLineZh: 管線操作員擁有變更日誌。

members.speakLineEn: Write an operative definition of the endpoint.
members.speakLineZh: 寫下終點的有效定義。

members.speakLineEn: An inoperative prereg is worse than none.
members.speakLineZh: 失效的預註冊比沒有更糟。

members.speakLineEn: Keep claims operable under missing data.
members.speakLineZh: 讓主張在缺失資料下仍可操作。

members.speakLineEn: Teams must cooperate on shared codebooks.
members.speakLineZh: 團隊必須共用編碼簿合作。

members.speakLineEn: Cooperation without audit is theater.
members.speakLineZh: 沒有稽核的合作是表演。

members.speakLineEn: Do not turn methods into opera without scores.
members.speakLineZh: 別把方法變成沒有樂譜的歌劇。

members.speakLineEn: Avoid operatic claims from tiny samples.
members.speakLineZh: 避免從小樣本唱出誇張主張。

members.speakLineEn: Treat each paper as an opus with a version tag.
members.speakLineZh: 把每篇論文當有版本號的作品。

members.speakLineEn: Run a methods workshop before launch.
members.speakLineZh: 上線前開方法工作坊。

clusters.hook: 字根 opt＝選／視——驗光室同時配眼鏡與人生選項。
clusters.script: option／optional 選配鏡片。adopt 認養一副觀點。optimism／optimum 樂觀到以為已是最佳。optic／synopsis／autopsy：看、總覽、剖開細看——醫師喊：先 synopsis 再選 option，別盲目 optimism。

members.speakLineEn: Keep a preregistered option for sensitivity checks.
members.speakLineZh: 預註冊保留敏感度檢查選項。

members.speakLineEn: Open code should not be optional for claims.
members.speakLineZh: 對主張而言開放程式碼不該可選。

members.speakLineEn: Adopt shared standards across sites.
members.speakLineZh: 跨站點採納共享標準。

members.speakLineEn: Optimism about n=30 needs a power check.
members.speakLineZh: 對 n=30 的樂觀需要檢定力檢查。

members.speakLineEn: There is no single optimum for every field.
members.speakLineZh: 沒有適用所有領域的單一最適。

members.speakLineEn: Fix the optic of the figure before debating taste.
members.speakLineZh: 辯論品味前先修好圖的視覺。

members.speakLineEn: Write a honest synopsis, not a trailer.
members.speakLineZh: 寫誠實梗概，不是預告片。

members.speakLineEn: Run a blameless autopsy on the failed launch.
members.speakLineZh: 對失敗上線做無責事後剖析。

members.speakLineEn: Optimize clarity before optimizing citation count.
members.speakLineZh: 先優化清晰再優化引用數。

members.speakLineEn: Be the optometrist of your assumptions.
members.speakLineZh: 做自己假設的驗光師。

members.speakLineEn: Track adoption of open tools quarterly.
members.speakLineZh: 每季追蹤開放工具採納。

members.speakLineEn: An optimal slogan is still not evidence.
members.speakLineZh: 最佳口號仍不是證據。

clusters.hook: 字根 ord＝秩序——櫃枱專管排隊、命令、普通與協調。
clusters.script: order 叫號排隊。ordinary 普通號；coordinate 協調多櫃。subordinate 下屬櫃員；insubordinate 不聽話翻櫃。ordinance 條例告示；ordain 正式任命——經理：先 order 再 ordinal 排名，別 insubordinate 亂改結局。

members.speakLineEn: State the analysis order before peeking.
members.speakLineZh: 偷看前先聲明分析順序。

members.speakLineEn: Ordinary diligence beats flashy shortcuts.
members.speakLineZh: 普通勤奮勝過炫目捷徑。

members.speakLineEn: Coordinate coding across raters.
members.speakLineZh: 跨評分者協調編碼。

members.senseAnchor: an assistant subject to the authority or control of another; a word that is more specific than a given word
members.speakLineEn: Do not subordinate ethics to speed.
members.speakLineZh: 不要讓倫理從屬於速度。

members.speakLineEn: Insubordinate silent forks wreck audits.
members.speakLineZh: 不服從的沉默分叉毀掉稽核。

members.senseAnchor: an authoritative rule; a statute enacted by a city government
members.speakLineEn: Follow the campus data ordinance.
members.speakLineZh: 遵守校園資料條例。

members.speakLineEn: Do not ordain a metric without validation.
members.speakLineZh: 未驗證不要正式規定指標。

members.speakLineEn: Ordinal ranks lose interval information.
members.speakLineZh: 序數排名失去區間資訊。

members.speakLineEn: Code disorder hides silent bugs.
members.speakLineZh: 程式混亂隱藏沉默錯誤。

members.speakLineEn: Appoint a data coordinator early.
members.speakLineZh: 及早任命資料協調者。

members.speakLineEn: Extraordinary claims need extraordinary evidence.
members.speakLineZh: 非凡主張需要非凡證據。

members.speakLineEn: Keep an orderly changelog.
members.speakLineZh: 保持有秩序的變更紀錄。

clusters.hook: 字根 ori＝升起、起源——導航台對準太陽升起的地方。
clusters.script: origin／originate 從哪升起。original 初升版本；orient／orientation 調整方向。aboriginal 最初住民意象；oriental（舊稱，謹慎）——領航員：找 origin 比找 oriental 標籤重要；orientation 週先講清楚。
pitfalls: oriental 現代英語常過時／冒犯，教學標註即可

members.speakLineEn: Trace the origin of each exclusion rule.
members.speakLineZh: 追溯每條排除規則的起源。

members.speakLineEn: Cite the original protocol, not a rumor.
members.speakLineZh: 引用原始規程，不是謠言。

members.speakLineEn: Orient new members to logging norms.
members.speakLineZh: 讓新人對準日誌規範。

members.speakLineEn: Ethics orientation is mandatory.
members.speakLineZh: 倫理導向訓練為必修。

members.speakLineEn: Respect aboriginal knowledge systems in fieldwork.
members.speakLineZh: 田野尊重原住民知識系統。

members.speakLineEn: Missing metadata can disorient reanalyzers.
members.speakLineZh: 缺中繼資料會讓再分析者迷失。

members.speakLineEn: Reorient incentives toward sharing.
members.speakLineZh: 把誘因重新導向共享。

members.speakLineEn: Originally preregistered outcomes must stay primary.
members.speakLineZh: 原先預註冊結局須維持主要。

members.speakLineEn: Treat day-one logs as the project's sunrise.
members.speakLineZh: 把第一天日誌當專案日出。

members.speakLineEn: Name every data source.
members.speakLineZh: 具名每個資料來源。

clusters.hook: 字根 paci＝和平——談判桌把怒火按下去，簽停戰，也識破假和平。
clusters.script: pacify／pacific／pacifist／pacifism 和解小組。peace／pax 停戰旗。truce／armistice／placid／calm 停火與平靜客串——主席：pacify conflicts with data；假 pacific 微笑不改錯，無效。

members.senseAnchor: cause to be more favorably inclined; gain the good will of; fight violence and try to establish peace in (a location)
members.speakLineEn: Pacify reviewer concerns with evidence.
members.speakLineZh: 用證據平息審稿疑慮。

members.speakLineEn: Keep a pacific tone while defending methods.
members.speakLineZh: 捍衛方法時保持平和語氣。

members.speakLineEn: Be a pacifist toward people, a hawk toward bias.
members.speakLineZh: 對人和平，對偏差強硬。

members.speakLineEn: Methodological pacifism is not ignoring fraud.
members.speakLineZh: 方法和平主義不是忽視造假。

members.speakLineEn: Make peace with null results by publishing them.
members.speakLineZh: 用發表與虛無結果和解。

members.speakLineEn: Declare a pax on outcome renaming midstream.
members.speakLineZh: 對中途改結局名稱下停戰令。

members.senseAnchor: a state of peace agreed to between opponents so they can discuss peace terms
members.speakLineEn: Call a truce: freeze the analysis plan.
members.speakLineZh: 喊休戰：凍結分析計畫。

members.speakLineEn: Sign an armistice with endless tweaking.
members.speakLineZh: 與無盡微調簽停戰。

members.senseAnchor: make (one thing) compatible with (another); bring into consonance or accord
members.speakLineEn: Reconcile codebook and code before lock.
members.speakLineZh: 鎖定前和解編碼簿與程式。

members.speakLineEn: A ceasefire on debate needs shared numbers.
members.speakLineZh: 辯論停火需要共享數字。

clusters.hook: 字根 pater/patr＝父——贊助會管父系、愛國、贊助人，也管「 dur patronizing」。
clusters.script: paternal／paternity／patriarch 父系大廳。patriot／patriotic 愛國啦啦隊。patron／patronage／patronize 贊助與屈尊俯就；expatriate／repatriate  expatriate 出走、送回——會長：patronize juniors 零分；patron open tools。
pitfalls: patronize＝贊助或擺出恩賜態度（雙義）

members.speakLineEn: Paternal leave is part of lab sustainability.
members.speakLineZh: 陪產假是實驗室永續一環。

members.speakLineEn: Claim paternity of errors as well as wins.
members.speakLineZh: 錯誤與勝利都要認父職。

members.speakLineEn: The patriarch still submits to prereg.
members.speakLineZh: 元老仍服從預註冊。

members.speakLineEn: Be a patriot of rigor, not of brands.
members.speakLineZh: 做嚴謹的愛國者，不是品牌的。

members.speakLineEn: Patriotic loyalty to a method can blind you.
members.speakLineZh: 對方法的愛國忠誠會致盲。

members.speakLineEn: Thank patrons without selling conclusions.
members.speakLineZh: 感謝贊助人但不出賣結論。

members.senseAnchor: the act of providing approval and support; customers collectively
members.speakLineEn: Disclose patronage that could bias design.
members.speakLineZh: 揭露可能偏差設計的贊助。

members.senseAnchor: assume sponsorship of; do one's shopping at; do business with; be a customer or client of
members.speakLineEn: Do not patronize readers with hand-waving.
members.speakLineZh: 別用含糊其辭屈尊對待讀者。

members.senseAnchor: a person who is voluntarily absent from home or country; expel from a country
members.speakLineEn: Expatriate datasets need local ethics care.
members.speakLineZh: 出境資料集需要在地倫理照護。

members.speakLineEn: Repatriate cleaned data to a locked vault.
members.speakLineZh: 把清乾淨資料送回鎖定庫。

members.speakLineEn: Name the sponsor beside the conflict box.
members.speakLineZh: 在利益衝突旁寫明贊助者。

Male head of family; founding elder:
Person living outside their native country:

clusters.hook: 字根 path＝感、受苦——診所專治『感不感得到』。
clusters.script: apathy 是掛號也不想感；empathy 能感同身受，sympathy 隔床安慰。pathos 是催淚橋段，pathetic 可憐到讓人感嘆。antipathy 天生反感，pathogen 讓身體受苦的病原；homeopathy 等療法名也帶 path，但考試先抓住『感／病』核心。
reviewHooks: path＝感／苦：apathy 無感、empathy 同感、sympathy 同情、antipathy 反感
pitfalls: empathy（代入感受）vs sympathy（同情／憐憫）層次不同
pathetic 口語常貶，學術上也可指『引發悲憫』

members.senseAnchor: an absence of emotion or enthusiasm; the trait of lacking enthusiasm for or interest in things generally
members.speakLineEn: Voter apathy can mute even strong reforms.
members.speakLineZh: 選民冷漠能使再強的改革也消音。

members.senseAnchor: understanding and entering into another's feelings
members.speakLineEn: Empathy aids interviewing but does not replace coding rules.
members.speakLineZh: 同理心有助訪談，但不能取代編碼規則。

members.speakLineEn: Sympathy alone cannot allocate scarce beds.
members.speakLineZh: 單靠同情無法分配稀缺床位。

members.speakLineEn: The speech relied more on pathos than on proof.
members.speakLineZh: 演說更依賴悲愴感染而非證據。

members.senseAnchor: deserving or inciting pity; ; ; - Galsworthy; inspiring mixed contempt and pity
members.speakLineEn: A pathetic sample size cannot support the claim.
members.speakLineZh: 可憐的樣本數支撐不起該主張。

members.senseAnchor: a feeling of intense dislike; the object of a feeling of intense aversion; something to be avoided
members.speakLineEn: Mutual antipathy stalled coalition talks.
members.speakLineZh: 相互反感讓聯盟談判停滯。

members.speakLineEn: The model treats misinformation like a pathogen.
members.speakLineZh: 該模型把錯誤訊息當成病原體。

members.senseAnchor: the branch of medical science that studies the causes and nature and effects of diseases; any deviation from a healthy or normal condition
members.speakLineEn: Organizational pathology showed up as chronic delay.
members.speakLineZh: 組織病態表現為長期拖延。

members.speakLineEn: Good editors are not telepathic; mark your claims.
members.speakLineZh: 好編輯不是心靈感應——請標明你的主張。

members.zhGloss: 反社會人格者（通俗用法）
members.senseAnchor: 反社會人格者（通俗用法）
members.speakLineEn: Popular media overuses “sociopath” as a slur.
members.speakLineZh: 大眾媒體過度把「sociopath」當罵人用語。

members.zhGloss: 順勢療法（名含 path；考構詞辨識）
members.senseAnchor: 順勢療法（名含 path；考構詞辨識）
members.speakLineEn: Etymology explains -pathy in homeopathy, but efficacy is a separate claim.
members.speakLineZh: 字源能解釋 homeopathy 裡的 -pathy，但療效是另一個命題。

quiz.promptZh: 從內部分享他人感受，更接近：

clusters.hook: 字根 ped/pod＝腳——實驗室專管腳步、障礙與兒童科雙關（ped- 也＝兒童）。
clusters.script: pedestrian 用腳走的平凡路。expedite 讓腳步加速放行；impede／impediment 絆腳石。pedestal 踮腳站的座；centipede／tripod 多腳怪與三腳架——教官：expedite 審核可以，impede 共享不行；pedestrian 寫作有時是美德。

members.senseAnchor: causing weariness, restlessness, or lack of interest
members.speakLineEn: Pedestrian clarity beats ornate fog.
members.speakLineZh: 平淡清晰勝過華麗迷霧。

members.speakLineEn: Expedite corrections, not hype.
members.speakLineZh: 加速勘誤，不是炒作。

members.speakLineEn: Paywalls impede cumulative science.
members.speakLineZh: 付費牆妨礙累積科學。

members.speakLineEn: Missing consent is an impediment to publish.
members.speakLineZh: 缺同意是發表障礙。

members.senseAnchor: a support or foundation; a position of great esteem (and supposed superiority)
members.speakLineEn: Do not put celebrities on a methods pedestal.
members.speakLineZh: 不要把名人放上方法基座。

members.speakLineEn: A centipede of covariates needs justification.
members.speakLineZh: 共變項蜈蚣需要理由。

members.speakLineEn: A tripod of prereg, code, and data stabilizes claims.
members.speakLineZh: 預註冊／程式碼／資料三腳架穩定主張。

members.speakLineEn: Pedal back from overclaim quietly—then loudly correct.
members.speakLineZh: 從過度宣稱踩煞車——然後大聲勘誤。

members.speakLineEn: Treat fieldwork like an expedition with logs.
members.speakLineZh: 田野像遠征，要有日誌。

members.speakLineEn: Even bipeds trip without checklists.
members.speakLineZh: 沒有檢核表兩足也會絆倒。

members.senseAnchor: a platform raised above the surrounding level to give prominence to the person on it
members.speakLineEn: The podium belongs to evidence, not vibes.
members.speakLineZh: 頒獎台屬於證據不是感覺。

members.speakLineEn: Minimize the privacy footprint of raw files.
members.speakLineZh: 最小化原始檔隱私足跡。
