clusters.hook: 字根 pel/puls＝推——被推走或被推動。
clusters.script: compel 強迫推動；expel 推出去；repel 推開。impulse 衝動推力，propel 向前推，dispel 驅散。pulse 脈搏，compel／compulsory 強制，expulsion 開除，repellent 令人反感，impel 驅使，pulsate 搏動。
pitfalls: repel 可指物理推開或令人反感

members.speakLineEn: Evidence should compel revision, not loyalty tests.
members.speakLineZh: 證據應強迫修正，而非忠誠測驗。

members.speakLineEn: Schools rarely expel for honest error, but silence does.
members.speakLineZh: 學校少因誠實錯誤開除，沉默卻會。

members.senseAnchor: cause to move back by force or influence; be repellent to; cause aversion in
members.speakLineEn: Opaque methods repel collaborators.
members.speakLineZh: 不透明方法讓合作者反感。

members.speakLineEn: Resist the impulse to peek at outcomes early.
members.speakLineZh: 忍住提早偷看結果的衝動。

members.senseAnchor: cause to move forward with force; give an incentive for action
members.speakLineEn: Clear stakes propel careful reading.
members.speakLineZh: 清楚利害推進細讀。

members.speakLineEn: Open data can dispel rumors of selective reporting.
members.speakLineZh: 開放資料能驅散選擇性報告謠言。

members.speakLineEn: Take the pulse of the literature with living reviews.
members.speakLineZh: 用持續評論為文獻把脈。

members.speakLineEn: Compulsory preregistration changes gaming incentives.
members.speakLineZh: 強制預註冊改變投機誘因。

members.senseAnchor: the act of forcing out someone or something; squeezing out by applying pressure
members.speakLineEn: Expulsion from a consortium should follow due process.
members.speakLineZh: 逐出聯盟應有正當程序。

members.speakLineEn: A repellent tone loses persuadable readers.
members.speakLineZh: 反感語氣失去可說服讀者。

members.senseAnchor: urge or force (a person) to an action; constrain or motivate; cause to move forward with force
members.speakLineEn: Curiosity should impel checks, not shortcuts.
members.speakLineZh: 好奇應驅使核查，而非捷徑。

members.speakLineEn: Attention pulsates with media cycles.
members.speakLineZh: 注意力隨媒體週期搏動。

members.senseAnchor: a propelling force; the act of propelling
members.speakLineEn: Citation propulsion is not the same as truth-tracking.
members.speakLineZh: 引用推進力≠追蹤真理。

members.senseAnchor: the force by which bodies repel one another; intense aversion
members.speakLineEn: Mutual repulsion between camps blocks synthesis.
members.speakLineZh: 陣營互斥阻礙綜整。

members.senseAnchor: an urge to do or say something that might be better left undone or unsaid; an irrational motive for performing trivial or repetitive actions, even against your will
members.speakLineEn: Under compulsion, consent is compromised.
members.speakLineZh: 強迫下同意已打折。

clusters.hook: 字根 pend/pens＝懸、稱、付——掛著的事最折磨人。
clusters.script: pending 懸而未決；suspend 暫時吊起來。depend 掛靠依賴，independent 不掛靠。append 附加，appendix 附錄。compensate 補償秤平，dispense 分配／免除，pensive 沉思掛著臉，expenditure 支出，pension 養老金，perpendicular 垂直掛線，impending 迫近懸在頭上。

members.speakLineEn: Results are pending ethics clearance.
members.speakLineZh: 結果尚待倫理審查。

members.speakLineEn: Suspend recruitment when adverse events cluster.
members.speakLineZh: 不良事件群聚時暫停收案。

members.speakLineEn: Estimates depend on the exclusion restriction.
members.speakLineZh: 估計依賴排除限制。

members.speakLineEn: Independent replication beats in-house confirmation.
members.speakLineZh: 獨立複現勝過內部確認。

members.speakLineEn: Append the codebook to the replication package.
members.speakLineZh: 把編碼簿附加到複現包。

members.speakLineEn: Put long tables in an appendix.
members.speakLineZh: 長表放附錄。

members.speakLineEn: Weighting can compensate for known nonresponse.
members.speakLineZh: 加權可補償已知不回應。

members.senseAnchor: administer or bestow, as in small portions; grant a dispensation; grant an exemption
members.speakLineEn: We can dispense with decorative citations.
members.speakLineZh: 我們可以免除裝飾性引用。

members.senseAnchor: thinking deeply about something that worries you
members.speakLineEn: A pensive tone is fine; vagueness is not.
members.speakLineZh: 沉思語氣可以；含糊不行。

members.senseAnchor: money paid out; an amount spent; the act of spending money for goods or services
members.speakLineEn: Track expenditure against preregistered milestones.
members.speakLineZh: 依預註冊里程碑追蹤支出。

members.speakLineEn: Pension systems illustrate long-horizon policy tradeoffs.
members.speakLineZh: 退休金制度說明長期政策取捨。

members.senseAnchor: a straight line at right angles to another line; a Gothic style in 14th and 15th century England; characterized by vertical lines and a four-centered (Tudor) arch and fan vaulting
members.speakLineEn: Keep axes perpendicular and honestly scaled.
members.speakLineZh: 軸線保持垂直且誠實刻度。

members.senseAnchor: be imminent or about to happen; close in time; about to occur
members.speakLineEn: Impending deadlines distort careful reading.
members.speakLineZh: 迫近截止扭曲細讀。

members.speakLineEn: A pendant caveat cannot rescue a broken design.
members.speakLineZh: 垂吊的但書救不了壞設計。

members.speakLineEn: Estimate propensity with covariates chosen ex ante.
members.speakLineZh: 用事先選好的共變估計傾向。

clusters.hook: 字根 pet＝求、衝——競技場專管往前衝與請求。
clusters.script: impetuous 腦袋還沒到腳先衝；impetus 衝量本身。petition 正式呈請；compete 互相衝第一。centripetal 往中心衝；appetite 慾望也在衝。perpetual 衝個不停；petulant 衝完還耍脾氣——教練：先想再衝。

members.senseAnchor: characterized by undue haste and lack of thought or deliberation; ; ; ; ; (`brainish' is archaic); marked by violent force
members.speakLineEn: Impetuous claims skip robustness.
members.speakLineZh: 衝動主張跳過穩健檢查。

members.speakLineEn: A scandal gave impetus to open-data rules.
members.speakLineZh: 醜聞給了開放資料規則動力。

members.speakLineEn: Petition journals for data policies.
members.speakLineZh: 向期刊請願要資料政策。

members.speakLineEn: Labs compete on speed; science needs care.
members.speakLineZh: 實驗室比速度；科學需要謹慎。

members.senseAnchor: tending to move toward a center; tending to unify
members.speakLineEn: Centripetal incentives can unify standards.
members.speakLineZh: 向心力誘因可統一標準。

members.speakLineEn: An appetite for novelty crowds replication.
members.speakLineZh: 嗜新慾望排擠複現。

members.speakLineEn: Perpetual revision without release helps no one.
members.speakLineZh: 永不發布的永久修改幫不了人。

members.speakLineEn: Petulant replies to reviewers backfire.
members.speakLineZh: 對審稿人暴躁回覆會反噬。

members.speakLineEn: Healthy competition shares tools.
members.speakLineZh: 健康競爭分享工具。

members.speakLineEn: Do not repeat the same silent fork.
members.speakLineZh: 不要重複同一沉默分叉。

members.speakLineEn: Keep petitionary emails specific.
members.speakLineZh: 請願郵件要具體。

members.speakLineEn: Run an impetus check: why rush?
members.speakLineZh: 做動力檢查：為何急？

clusters.hook: 字根 phil＝愛——後援會專管「愛到 dedic ate」的各種粉絲。
clusters.script: 哲學系社長 philosophy 愛智慧愛到睡不著；philately 郵迷把郵票當戀人。bibliophile 抱著書睡，cinephile 抱著片子哭，technophile 抱著新gadget笑。philanthropy／philanthropist 愛人類到願意掏腰包；anglophile 英倫迷連雨都覺得浪漫；philharmonic 愛和諧所以組樂團——場外還有 philology 語言考古粉在挖字根。
pitfalls: philanthropy＝慈善博愛，不是 philately（集郵）

members.speakLineEn: State your philosophy of evidence before the claim.
members.speakLineZh: 先講你的證據哲學再出主張。

members.senseAnchor: the collection and study of postage stamps
members.speakLineEn: His philately collection funded open-data prizes.
members.speakLineZh: 他的集郵收藏資助了開放資料獎。

members.speakLineEn: A bibliophile still needs digital backups.
members.speakLineZh: 愛書人仍需數位備份。

members.speakLineEn: Cinephile taste is not a methods validation.
members.speakLineZh: 影迷品味不是方法驗證。

members.speakLineEn: Technophiles over-trust shiny dashboards.
members.speakLineZh: 科技迷過度信任閃亮儀表板。

members.speakLineEn: Philanthropy without transparency can distort agendas.
members.speakLineZh: 不透明的慈善可能扭曲議程。

members.speakLineEn: Name the philanthropist and the strings attached.
members.speakLineZh: 具名慈善家與附帶條件。

members.speakLineEn: Anglophile framing is not cross-cultural proof.
members.speakLineZh: 親英框架不是跨文化證明。

members.speakLineEn: The philharmonic metaphor: many instruments, one score.
members.speakLineZh: 愛樂隱喻：多樂器共一總譜。

members.senseAnchor: the humanistic study of language and literature
members.speakLineEn: Philology reminds us words drift in meaning.
members.speakLineZh: 語文學提醒詞義會漂。

members.speakLineEn: Audiophile gear cannot fix a noisy design.
members.speakLineZh: 音響迷裝備修不好嘈雜設計。

members.speakLineEn: A xenophile lab invites outsider critique.
members.speakLineZh: 喜好異文化的實驗室歡迎外人批評。

clusters.hook: 字根 phob＝怕——遊樂園每扇門都寫著「我不要進去」。
clusters.script: 門口掛 phobia 總招牌。claustrophobia 怕密閉電梯；agoraphobia 怕廣場人潮；acrophobia 怕高空旋轉杯；xenophobia 怕「外人」進場。hydrophobia 怕水（也聯狂犬病典故）；technophobia 怕新按鈕；phobic 形容整個人都在抖——記得：怕≠恨，但 xenophobia 常變成歧視劇本。
pitfalls: hydrophobia 醫學典故＝恐水／狂犬病相關

members.speakLineEn: Call it a phobia only with clinical care, not as insult.
members.speakLineZh: 稱恐懼症要謹慎，勿當侮辱。

members.speakLineEn: Agoraphobia metaphors misuse public fear casually.
members.speakLineZh: 廣場恐懼隱喻常被隨便用。

members.speakLineEn: Acrophobia is not an excuse to skip remote sites.
members.speakLineZh: 懼高不是跳過遠端站點的藉口。

members.speakLineEn: Xenophobia poisons collaborative science.
members.speakLineZh: 排外恐懼毒害合作科學。

members.speakLineEn: Historical 'hydrophobia' labels need careful glossing.
members.speakLineZh: 歷史「恐水」標籤需謹慎釋義。

members.speakLineEn: Technophobia can slow useful tooling adoption.
members.speakLineZh: 科技恐懼會拖慢有用工具採用。

members.speakLineEn: Phobic reactions to critique block learning.
members.speakLineZh: 對批評的恐懼反應阻擋學習。

members.speakLineEn: Homophobia has no place in research ethics.
members.speakLineZh: 恐同歧視在研究倫理中沒有位置。

members.speakLineEn: Arachnophobia jokes still need consent in class.
members.speakLineZh: 蜘蛛恐懼玩笑課堂仍需同意。

members.speakLineEn: Photophobia can be a medical symptom, not a metaphor toy.
members.speakLineZh: 畏光可以是醫學症狀，不是隱喻玩具。

members.speakLineEn: Drop casual '-phobe' labels in scholarly tone.
members.speakLineZh: 學術語氣少用隨便的 -phobe 標籤。

members.speakLineEn: A phobic response to null results wastes cohorts.
members.speakLineZh: 對虛無結果的恐懼反應浪費世代。

flow.name: 鉤子
flow.content: 字根 phob＝怕——遊樂園每扇門都寫著「我不要進去」。

flow.name: 串記劇本
flow.content: 門口掛 phobia 總招牌。claustrophobia 怕密閉電梯；agoraphobia 怕廣場人潮；acrophobia 怕高空旋轉杯；xenophobia 怕「外人」進場。hydrophobia 怕水（也聯狂犬病典故）；technophobia 怕新按鈕；phobic 形容整個人都在抖——記得：怕≠恨，但 xenophobia 常變成歧視劇本。

clusters.hook: 字根 phon＝聲——控制室推桿：好聽、難聽、假聲、真聲。
clusters.script: euphony 調成悅耳；cacophony 調成災難演唱會。symphony 多聲部合奏；phonetic 按發音標記。homophone 同音撞名事故；megaphone／microphone／telephone 把聲音放大、接收、遠傳。phonology 管語音規則——工程師說：寫作要 euphony，會議別 cacophony。

members.speakLineEn: Aim for euphony without sacrificing precision.
members.speakLineZh: 追求悅耳但不犧牲精確。

members.senseAnchor: a loud harsh or strident noise; loud confusing disagreeable sounds
members.speakLineEn: A cacophony of metrics confuses readers.
members.speakLineZh: 指標刺耳嘈雜迷惑讀者。

members.speakLineEn: Team science should sound like a symphony, not solos only.
members.speakLineZh: 團隊科學應像交響而非只有獨奏。

members.senseAnchor: of or relating to speech sounds; of or relating to the scientific study of speech sounds
members.speakLineEn: Provide phonetic guides for hard headwords.
members.speakLineZh: 難詞提供語音指引。

members.speakLineEn: Homophones cause TTS and quiz traps.
members.speakLineZh: 同音異義造成 TTS 與測驗陷阱。

members.speakLineEn: Phonology is optional; sense accuracy is not.
members.speakLineZh: 音韻學可選；義準不可選。

members.speakLineEn: Do not use press megaphones for tiny pilots.
members.speakLineZh: 小試點別用記者會擴音器。

members.speakLineEn: A quiet microphone still records admissions.
members.speakLineZh: 安靜麥克風仍錄得到承認。

members.speakLineEn: Telephone interviews need consent scripts.
members.speakLineZh: 電話訪談需要同意腳本。

members.speakLineEn: A symphony of errors starts with one silent fork.
members.speakLineZh: 錯誤交響常始於一次沉默分叉。

members.speakLineEn: Phonic clarity helps oral drills.
members.speakLineZh: 聲音清晰幫助口語操練。

members.speakLineEn: Cacophonous debates still need minutes.
members.speakLineZh: 刺耳辯論仍需會議紀錄。

clusters.hook: 字根 plac＝平息／討好——接待室專管安撫、平靜、討好與和解。
clusters.script: placid 水面平靜。placate 安撫怒審。placebo 安慰劑糖。complacent／complacency 自滿沙發；implacable 安撫不了——接待：placate egos after critique；complacent labs 危險。

members.senseAnchor: (of a body of water) free from disturbance by heavy waves; not easily irritated
members.speakLineEn: Keep a placid tone in rebuttals.
members.speakLineZh: 反駁保持平靜語氣。

members.senseAnchor: cause to be more favorably inclined; gain the good will of
members.speakLineEn: Placate concerns with data, not adjectives.
members.speakLineZh: 用資料安撫疑慮，不是形容詞。

members.senseAnchor: an innocuous or inert medication; given as a pacifier or to the control group in experiments on the efficacy of a drug; (Roman Catholic Church) vespers of the office for the dead
members.speakLineEn: Placebo arms still need outcome locks.
members.speakLineZh: 安慰劑臂仍需結局鎖定。

members.speakLineEn: Complacent labs skip audits.
members.speakLineZh: 自滿實驗室跳過稽核。

members.speakLineEn: Complacency about p-hacking is contagious.
members.speakLineZh: 對 p 操弄的自滿會傳染。

members.speakLineEn: Implacable skepticism is fine; bad faith is not.
members.speakLineZh: 無法平息的懷疑沒問題；惡意不行。

members.speakLineEn: A plea for urgency is not a design.
members.speakLineZh: 懇求急迫不是設計。

members.speakLineEn: Do not please editors by hiding nulls.
members.speakLineZh: 不要為取悅編輯隱藏虛無。

members.speakLineEn: Pleasant culture still needs hard reviews.
members.speakLineZh: 愉快文化仍需嚴格審查。

members.senseAnchor: cause to be more favorably inclined; gain the good will of; overcome or allay
members.speakLineEn: Appease funders with milestones, not fake p.
members.speakLineZh: 用里程碑安撫資助者，不是假 p。

members.speakLineEn: Soothe anxiety with checklists.
members.speakLineZh: 用清單撫慰焦慮。

clusters.hook: 字根 popul＝民——廣場上擠滿人潮、民粹喇叭與冷清角落。
clusters.script: popular／unpopular／popularize 人氣燈。populate／population／populous／populace 人潮統計。populist／depopulate 民粹喇叭與清空場——市長：populace ≠ sample；populist shortcuts 禁。

members.speakLineEn: Popular metrics can still be wrong.
members.speakLineZh: 流行指標仍可能錯。

members.speakLineEn: Unpopular nulls deserve publication.
members.speakLineZh: 不受歡迎的虛無也該發表。

members.speakLineEn: Popularize prereg without dumbing it down.
members.speakLineZh: 普及預註冊但不簡化到失真。

members.speakLineEn: Populate the codebook before the model.
members.speakLineZh: 建模前先填滿編碼簿。

members.speakLineEn: State the population you can actually reach.
members.speakLineZh: 說清你真正能觸及的母體。

members.speakLineEn: Populous multi-site studies need site effects.
members.speakLineZh: 人口稠密多站研究需要站點效應。

members.speakLineEn: Do not confuse online populace with the frame.
members.speakLineZh: 別把線上人群當抽樣架構。

members.speakLineEn: Populist certainty is not statistical certainty.
members.speakLineZh: 民粹確定不是統計確定。

members.speakLineEn: Depopulate junk variables before fitting.
members.speakLineZh: 擬合前清空垃圾變數。

members.speakLineEn: Crowd applause is not peer review.
members.speakLineZh: 人群掌聲不是同儕審查。

members.speakLineEn: Keep public corrections faster than rumors.
members.speakLineZh: 公開勘誤要比謠言快。

quiz.promptEn: Appealing to ordinary people; often anti-elite:

flow.name: 鉤子
flow.content: 字根 popul＝民——廣場上擠滿人潮、民粹喇叭與冷清角落。

clusters.hook: 字根 port＝運、帶——碼頭專管進出口與重要消息。
clusters.script: 貨物 import 運入、export 運出；deport 把人運出境。portable 可攜，transport 整段運輸。important 有重量；opportune／opportunity 剛好靠岸。support 托住，report 運回消息；portfolio 一組可運資產，purport 聲稱運載何義，insupportable 托不住。
pitfalls: deport 驅人 ≠ export 運貨
important 勿只記『重要』忘構詞重量感

members.speakLineEn: The import of the finding is practical, not merely theoretical.
members.speakLineZh: 該發現的重要性是實務的。

members.speakLineEn: Methods that export poorly across cultures need local tests.
members.speakLineZh: 難跨文化輸出的方法需在地檢驗。

members.speakLineEn: The metaphor of deporting outliers can hide selection bias.
members.speakLineZh: 『驅逐極端值』可能掩蓋選擇偏差。

members.speakLineEn: A portable checklist travels between labs.
members.speakLineZh: 可移植檢核表能在實驗室間旅行。

members.senseAnchor: a state of overwhelming usually pleasurable emotion
members.speakLineEn: How we transport samples affects degradation.
members.speakLineZh: 樣本運輸方式影響降解。

members.speakLineEn: Important claims deserve pre-registered tests.
members.speakLineZh: 重要主張值得預註冊檢驗。

members.senseAnchor: suitable or at a time that is suitable or advantageous especially for a particular purpose
members.speakLineEn: An opportune pause let cooler evidence speak.
members.speakLineZh: 合時停頓讓冷靜證據說話。

members.speakLineEn: Missing data is also a missed opportunity for honesty.
members.speakLineZh: 缺漏資料也是錯失誠實機會。

members.speakLineEn: Correlations alone rarely support causal claims.
members.speakLineZh: 單靠相關很少支撐因果。

members.speakLineEn: Report effect sizes with intervals, not stars alone.
members.speakLineZh: 報告效應量請帶區間。

members.speakLineEn: A methods portfolio beats a single fashionable tool.
members.speakLineZh: 方法組合勝過單一流行工具。

members.senseAnchor: the intended meaning of a communication; the pervading meaning or tenor
members.speakLineEn: The statute purports to protect privacy broadly.
members.speakLineZh: 法條聲稱要廣泛保護隱私。

members.speakLineEn: That leap from survey to policy is insupportable.
members.speakLineZh: 從問卷跳到政策無法支撐。

members.speakLineEn: Think of operationalization as the porter of concepts.
members.speakLineZh: 操作型定義像概念搬運工。

members.zhGloss: 運動；炫耀（古義 disport 近）
members.senseAnchor: an active diversion requiring physical exertion and competition; the occupation of athletes who compete for pay
members.speakLineEn: Do not sport with definitions mid-argument.
members.speakLineZh: 論證中途不要拿定義嬉戲。

clusters.hook: 字根 pos/pon＝放、置——誰被放哪裡，誰說了算。
clusters.script: propose 放上桌；impose 強加。compose 組裝，dispose 處置，expose 揭露，oppose 對放反對。postpone 往後放；component 零件，positive 明確肯定，deposit 存放。juxtapose 並置，superimpose 疊加，proposition 命題，exponent 倡導者，repository 儲庫。

members.speakLineEn: We propose a preregistered analysis plan.
members.speakLineZh: 我們提議預註冊分析計畫。

members.speakLineEn: Do not impose a narrative the data cannot carry.
members.speakLineZh: 不要強加資料扛不起的敘事。

members.speakLineEn: Compose the abstract after results are stable.
members.speakLineZh: 結果穩定後再寫摘要。

members.speakLineEn: How labs dispose of failed trials shapes the literature.
members.speakLineZh: 失敗試驗怎麼處置形塑文獻。

members.speakLineEn: Replication can expose fragile findings.
members.speakLineZh: 複現能揭露脆弱發現。

members.speakLineEn: Stakeholders may oppose transparency that threatens rents.
members.speakLineZh: 利害關係人可能反對威脅租金的透明。

members.speakLineEn: Postpone celebration until robustness checks pass.
members.speakLineZh: 穩健檢查通過前先延期慶祝。

members.speakLineEn: Trust is a component of cumulative science.
members.speakLineZh: 信任是累積科學的元件。

members.speakLineEn: A positive result still needs a credible mechanism.
members.speakLineZh: 陽性結果仍需可信機制。

members.speakLineEn: Deposit raw files in a trusted repository.
members.speakLineZh: 原始檔存進可信儲庫。

members.speakLineEn: Juxtapose the two models to show the gap.
members.speakLineZh: 並置兩模型以顯示差距。

members.speakLineEn: A public repository reduces private hoarding of data.
members.speakLineZh: 公開儲庫減少私藏。

members.senseAnchor: (logic) a statement that affirms or denies something and is either true or false; a proposal offered for acceptance or rejection
members.speakLineEn: State the proposition before you defend it.
members.speakLineZh: 先陳述命題再辯護。

members.speakLineEn: Do not superimpose ideology on measurement choices.
members.speakLineZh: 不要把意識形態疊加在測量上。

members.speakLineEn: An early exponent of open methods faced resistance.
members.speakLineZh: 開放方法早期倡導者遇阻力。

clusters.hook: 字根 pot＝能、力——電位室量誰有力、誰無力。
clusters.script: potent 有力；impotent 無力。potential／potency 潛力與效力。omnipotent 全能；potentate 掌權者。plenipotentiary 全權代表。
pitfalls: impotent＝無力／無效，語境可敏感但 GRE 常指無力

members.speakLineEn: A potent design still needs honest reporting.
members.speakLineZh: 強效設計仍需誠實報告。

members.speakLineEn: Unenforced policies are impotent.
members.speakLineZh: 不執行的政策無力。

members.speakLineEn: State the potential for harm explicitly.
members.speakLineZh: 明確陳述潛在傷害。

members.speakLineEn: Estimate the potency of the intervention.
members.speakLineZh: 估計介入效力。

members.speakLineEn: No statistician is omnipotent across designs.
members.speakLineZh: 沒有統計學家跨設計全能。

members.senseAnchor: a ruler who is unconstrained by law
members.speakLineEn: Do not let a single potentate gatekeep methods.
members.speakLineZh: 別讓單一掌權者把關方法。

members.speakLineEn: A plenipotentiary negotiator still needs counsel.
members.speakLineZh: 全權談判者仍需顧問。

members.speakLineEn: Map potentiality before claiming inevitability.
members.speakLineZh: 宣稱必然前先畫潛能。

members.speakLineEn: Empower juniors to halt unsafe protocols.
members.speakLineZh: 賦權資淺者叫停不安全規程。

members.speakLineEn: Powerful computers do not excuse weak theory.
members.speakLineZh: 強大電腦不恕弱理論。

members.speakLineEn: Whistleblowers can feel powerless without policy.
members.speakLineZh: 無政策時吹哨者可感無力。

members.speakLineEn: Reject fantasies of methodological omnipotence.
members.speakLineZh: 拒絕方法全能幻想。

clusters.hook: 字根 prehend/prise＝抓——鑑識課專抓罪犯、抓重點、抓到驚喜。
clusters.script: apprehend 抓住嫌犯；comprehend／comprehensive 全面抓住意思。reprehend／reprehensible 抓出來罵。surprise／enterprise／comprise／prize 驚喜、事業、包含、獎杯——教官：apprehensive 可以；reprehensible 造假抓起來。
pitfalls: comprise＝包含（不是 composed of 的反向乱用）

members.speakLineEn: Apprehend the confound before you celebrate.
members.speakLineZh: 慶祝前先抓住混淆因子。

members.speakLineEn: If readers cannot comprehend it, rewrite.
members.speakLineZh: 讀者抓不住意思就重寫。

members.speakLineEn: A comprehensive audit beats a heroic patch.
members.speakLineZh: 全面稽核勝過英雄式修補。

members.speakLineEn: Reprehend silent outcome switching.
members.speakLineZh: 譴責沉默的結局替換。

members.speakLineEn: Fabrication is reprehensible, full stop.
members.speakLineZh: 捏造應受譴責，句號。

members.speakLineEn: Be apprehensive of convenience samples.
members.speakLineZh: 對方便樣本保持憂慮。

members.speakLineEn: Preregistration reduces harmful surprise.
members.speakLineZh: 預註冊減少有害驚喜。

members.speakLineEn: Treat the project as a public enterprise.
members.speakLineZh: 把專案當公共事業。

members.speakLineEn: The sample should comprise all eligible cases.
members.speakLineZh: 樣本應包含所有合格個案。

members.speakLineEn: Prize transparency over theatrical novelty.
members.speakLineZh: 珍視透明勝過表演式新奇。

members.speakLineEn: Fear of reprisal kills error reporting.
members.speakLineZh: 怕報復會殺死錯誤回報。

members.speakLineEn: Do not prison inconvenient nulls in a drawer.
members.speakLineZh: 別把麻煩虛無關進抽屜。

clusters.hook: 字根 press＝壓——印刷廠專管壓力、表達、印象與壓制。
clusters.script: press／pressure／pressing 機器壓力。express／expression／expressive 把墨擠出來。impress／impression／impressive 印出印象。oppress／repress／suppress 往下壓——廠長：suppress nulls 零分；express uncertainty。

members.speakLineEn: Do not let the press timeline force peeking.
members.speakLineZh: 別讓新聞時程逼出偷看。

members.speakLineEn: Deadline pressure is not a methods excuse.
members.speakLineZh: 期限壓力不是方法藉口。

members.senseAnchor: the act of pressing; the exertion of pressure; a metal or plastic part that is made by a mechanical press
members.speakLineEn: A pressing question still needs a design.
members.speakLineZh: 急迫問題仍需要設計。

members.speakLineEn: Express limitations in the abstract.
members.speakLineZh: 在摘要表達限制。

members.speakLineEn: Keep the expression of results proportional.
members.speakLineZh: 結果表達要成比例。

members.speakLineEn: Expressive plots still need error bars.
members.speakLineZh: 富表達圖仍需誤差條。

members.speakLineEn: Impress reviewers with audits, not adjectives.
members.speakLineZh: 用稽核打動審稿，不是形容詞。

members.speakLineEn: First impressions of p-values mislead.
members.speakLineZh: 對 p 值的第一印象常誤導。

members.speakLineEn: Impressive effect sizes need robustness checks.
members.speakLineZh: 驚人效應量需要穩健檢查。

members.senseAnchor: come down on or keep down by unjust use of one's authority; cause to suffer
members.speakLineEn: Do not oppress dissent in lab meetings.
members.speakLineZh: 實驗室會議不要壓迫異議。

members.speakLineEn: Repress the urge to drop outliers silently.
members.speakLineZh: 壓抑沉默丟掉離群的衝動。

members.speakLineEn: Never suppress inconvenient nulls.
members.speakLineZh: 永不隱瞞麻煩的虛無。

clusters.hook: 字根 prim＝第一——櫃枱專管首要、原始、首相與『裝正經』。
clusters.script: primary／primarily 第一優先章。prime 質數／最佳檔；primitive 原始工具。premier／primeval 首席與遠古。prim 裝正經——櫃員：primary outcome 先鎖；prim manners 幫不了 p 值。

members.speakLineEn: Lock the primary outcome before peeking.
members.speakLineZh: 偷看前鎖定主要結局。

members.speakLineEn: This paper is primarily about measurement.
members.speakLineZh: 本文首要關於測量。

members.speakLineEn: Prime the team with a checklist.
members.speakLineZh: 用檢核表先啟動團隊。

members.speakLineEn: Primitive tools beat opaque black boxes.
members.speakLineZh: 簡陋工具勝過不透明黑箱。

members.speakLineEn: Premier journals still retract.
members.speakLineZh: 一流期刊仍撤稿。

members.speakLineEn: Primeval habits of hoarding data must end.
members.speakLineZh: 囤資料的遠古習慣必須結束。

members.speakLineEn: Prim tone cannot replace open code.
members.speakLineZh: 裝正經語氣不能取代開放程式碼。

members.speakLineEn: Write a primer for new coders.
members.speakLineZh: 為新編碼者寫入門。

members.senseAnchor: having existed from the beginning; in an earliest or original stage or state
members.speakLineEn: Ask the primordial question: what is the estimand?
members.speakLineZh: 問根本問題：目標量是什麼？

members.speakLineEn: First, preregister.
members.speakLineZh: 第一，預註冊。

members.speakLineEn: Foremost: do not fabricate.
members.speakLineZh: 最重要：不要捏造。

members.speakLineEn: Make correction a priority over celebration.
members.speakLineZh: 勘誤優先於慶祝。

flow.content: quiz ×3

clusters.hook: 字根 priv＝私——金庫專管私人、剝奪、特權鑰匙。
clusters.script: private／privacy 鎖進金庫。deprive 把鑰匙拿走；privation 被剝到空。privilege 特殊鑰匙；privy 知情的自己人——守衛：privilege 要揭露，privacy 要保護識別資訊。

members.speakLineEn: Keep private keys off shared slides.
members.speakLineZh: 私鑰別放共享投影片。

members.speakLineEn: Privacy requires more than anonymized names.
members.speakLineZh: 隱私不只是匿名姓名。

members.senseAnchor: take away possessions from someone; keep from having, keeping, or obtaining
members.speakLineEn: Do not deprive reviewers of code access.
members.speakLineZh: 不要剝奪審稿人程式碼近用。

members.senseAnchor: a state of extreme poverty; act of depriving someone of food or money or rights
members.speakLineEn: Privation of tooling hits poorer labs hardest.
members.speakLineZh: 工具匱乏最傷較窮實驗室。

members.speakLineEn: Disclose privilege and funding ties.
members.speakLineZh: 揭露特權與資助關係。

members.speakLineEn: Only those privy to raw IDs need clearance.
members.speakLineZh: 只有知情原始 ID 者需通關。

members.speakLineEn: Privatization of essential data harms equity.
members.speakLineZh: 必要資料私有化傷害公平。

members.speakLineEn: Waive fees for underprivileged authors.
members.speakLineZh: 為弱勢作者減免費用。

members.speakLineEn: Resolve disputes privately, correct publicly.
members.speakLineZh: 私下解決爭議，公開勘誤。

members.speakLineEn: Secrecy about exclusions is misconduct-adjacent.
members.speakLineZh: 對排除保密近乎不端。

members.speakLineEn: Mark confidential fields before sharing.
members.speakLineZh: 共享前標記機密欄位。

members.speakLineEn: Exclusive clubs slow cumulative science.
members.speakLineZh: 排外俱樂部拖慢累積科學。

clusters.hook: 字根 prob＝試、好——法庭專管試探、核准、正直與敗類。
clusters.script: probe 探針進場。probity 正直法官。approbation 核准掌聲；reprobate 敗類被告。probation 觀察期；improbable 機率低到法庭皺眉——書記官：probe 要有協議，probity 不能只靠自我介紹。

members.senseAnchor: n. 深入調查 a penetrating or critical investigation
members.speakLineEn: Probe the missingness mechanism.
members.speakLineZh: 探查缺失機制。

members.senseAnchor: complete and confirmed integrity; having strong moral principles
members.speakLineEn: Hire for probity, not only h-index.
members.speakLineZh: 聘人看正直，不只 h 指數。

members.senseAnchor: official approval; official recognition or approval
members.speakLineEn: Seek approbation via registered reports.
members.speakLineZh: 用註冊報告尋求核准。

members.senseAnchor: a person without moral scruples; reject (documents) as invalid
members.speakLineEn: Reprobate fraud without theatrical cruelty.
members.speakLineZh: 譴責造假但不作秀殘忍。

members.speakLineEn: New metrics stay on probation until validated.
members.speakLineZh: 新指標驗證前留在觀察期。

members.speakLineEn: An improbable effect size needs skepticism.
members.speakLineZh: 不太可能的效應量需要懷疑。

members.speakLineEn: State probability models explicitly.
members.speakLineZh: 明確陳述機率模型。

members.speakLineEn: Only probative logs enter the record.
members.speakLineZh: 只有可作證據的日誌進紀錄。

members.speakLineEn: Ethics approval is not scientific proof.
members.speakLineZh: 倫理批准不是科學證明。

members.speakLineEn: Disapprove hype in cover letters.
members.speakLineZh: 反對投稿信炒作。

members.speakLineEn: Test preregistered hypotheses first.
members.speakLineZh: 先檢驗預註冊假說。

members.speakLineEn: Keep a trial period for new dashboards.
members.speakLineZh: 新儀表板保留試用期。

clusters.hook: 字根 propri＝適當／己有——禮儀社專管「這是誰的」與「這樣得體嗎」。
clusters.script: proper／improper／propriety 得體門禁。property／proprietary／proprietor 產權與老闆章。appropriate／appropriation／expropriate 撥用、挪用、徵收——社長：appropriate methods；improper peeking 趕出門。

members.speakLineEn: Use the proper unit of analysis.
members.speakLineZh: 使用適當的分析單位。

members.speakLineEn: Improper unblinding voids the trial spirit.
members.speakLineZh: 不當破盲摧毀試驗精神。

members.speakLineEn: Scientific propriety includes sharing negatives.
members.speakLineZh: 科學得體包含分享負結果。

members.speakLineEn: State which property of the estimator you care about.
members.speakLineZh: 說清你在意估計式的哪種性質。

members.senseAnchor: an unincorporated business owned by a single person who is responsible for its liabilities and entitled to its profits; protected by trademark or patent or copyright; made or produced or distributed by one having exclusive rights
members.speakLineEn: Prefer open tools over proprietary black boxes.
members.speakLineZh: 寧可開放工具，不要專有黑箱。

members.speakLineEn: The data proprietor still owes documentation.
members.speakLineZh: 資料業主仍欠文件。

members.speakLineEn: Choose an appropriate loss function.
members.speakLineZh: 選擇適當的損失函數。

members.speakLineEn: Silent appropriation of others' code needs citation.
members.speakLineZh: 沉默挪用他人程式碼需引用。

members.speakLineEn: Do not expropriate credit from juniors.
members.speakLineZh: 不要徵收資淺者的功勞。

members.speakLineEn: Clarify ownership of analysis decisions.
members.speakLineZh: 釐清分析決策的所有權。

members.speakLineEn: Keep identifiable belongings out of public dumps.
members.speakLineZh: 可識別個資別丟進公開垃圾桶。

members.speakLineEn: Lab etiquette: correct the record fast.
members.speakLineZh: 實驗室禮儀：快速更正紀錄。

quiz.promptEn: Take away private property by authority:

clusters.hook: 字根 pugn＝打——擂台專管用拳與用嘴打架。
clusters.script: pugnacious 一上台就想打。impugn 出拳打對方名譽；oppugn 對打質疑。repugnant 讓人反感到想離場。pugilist 職業拳手；inexpugnable 要塞打不穿——裁判舉手：學術擂台打論點，別打人。

members.senseAnchor: having a quarrelsome or combative nature
members.speakLineEn: Pugnacious tone sinks valid critique.
members.speakLineZh: 好鬥語氣毁掉有效批評。

members.speakLineEn: Do not impugn motives without evidence.
members.speakLineZh: 沒證據不要抨擊動機。

members.speakLineEn: Fraud is ethically repugnant.
members.speakLineZh: 造假在倫理上令人厭惡。

members.speakLineEn: Be a pugilist for methods, not for egos.
members.speakLineZh: 為方法當拳手，不為自我。

members.speakLineEn: Oppugn the identification, politely.
members.speakLineZh: 禮貌地質疑識別策略。

members.speakLineEn: No claim is inexpugnable to new data.
members.speakLineZh: 沒有主張能對新資料堅不可摧。

members.speakLineEn: Pugnacity without rigor is noise.
members.speakLineZh: 沒有嚴謹的好鬥是噪音。

members.speakLineEn: Fight bias with design, not vibes.
members.speakLineZh: 用設計打偏差，不是感覺。

members.speakLineEn: Combat p-hacking with registration.
members.speakLineZh: 用註冊對抗 p 操弄。

members.senseAnchor: someone who fights (or is fighting); characteristic of an enemy or one eager to fight
members.speakLineEn: Belligerent emails escalate nothing useful.
members.speakLineZh: 好戰郵件升級不出有用東西。

members.speakLineEn: Do not antagonize reviewers with sarcasm.
members.speakLineZh: 不要用諷刺激怒審稿人。

members.speakLineEn: Unassailable claims are rare—show your work.
members.speakLineZh: 無可指摘的主張很稀有——展示過程。

flow.content: quiz ×3

clusters.hook: 字根 punct＝點、刺——禮儀所專管準點與刺痛良心。
clusters.script: punctual 準點；puncture 刺破。punctilious 對細節一絲不苟；compunction 良心刺痛。punctuate 加標點／強調；punctuation 標點。acupuncture 針刺。

members.speakLineEn: Be punctual with correction notices.
members.speakLineZh: 勘誤通知要準時。

members.speakLineEn: One leak can puncture a privacy plan.
members.speakLineZh: 一次洩漏可刺破隱私計畫。

members.speakLineEn: Punctilious citation prevents ghost references.
members.speakLineZh: 一絲不苟引用防止幽靈文獻。

members.senseAnchor: a feeling of guilt or regret
members.speakLineEn: Feel compunction about quiet exclusions.
members.speakLineZh: 對沉默排除感到內疚。

members.speakLineEn: Punctuate limitations clearly.
members.speakLineZh: 清楚強調限制。

members.speakLineEn: Bad punctuation can scramble claims.
members.speakLineZh: 糟糕標點會打亂主張。

members.speakLineEn: Think of audits as methodological acupuncture—precise, not theatrical.
members.speakLineZh: 把稽核當方法針灸：精準不作秀。

members.speakLineEn: Ask pointed questions about missingness.
members.speakLineZh: 對缺失問尖銳問題。

members.speakLineEn: Pointless metrics waste cohorts.
members.speakLineZh: 無意義指標浪費世代。

members.speakLineEn: Appoint an independent data steward.
members.speakLineZh: 任命獨立資料管家。

members.speakLineEn: Overclaiming will disappoint readers later.
members.speakLineZh: 過度宣稱稍後令讀者失望。

members.speakLineEn: Offer a counterpoint in the discussion.
members.speakLineZh: 在討論提供對位觀點。

quiz.promptEn: Attentive to fine points of etiquette/detail:

clusters.hook: 字根 put＝想、算——櫃門寫著：爭議、聲譽、計算、委派。
clusters.script: compute 先算。dispute 吵著算不清；reputation 聲譽櫃台。impute 把責任算到某人頭上；putative 據稱的候選人。deputy 代理計算員；computer 機器算盤——櫃員：impute 缺失要有模型，別亂 dispute 到沒日誌。

members.speakLineEn: Compute intervals, not stars alone.
members.speakLineZh: 計算區間，不只星號。

members.speakLineEn: Document the dispute trail.
members.speakLineZh: 記錄爭議軌跡。

members.speakLineEn: Reputation should not exempt audits.
members.speakLineZh: 聲譽不該豁免稽核。

members.senseAnchor: attribute or credit to; attribute (responsibility or fault) to a cause or source
members.speakLineEn: Impute missingness cautiously and report it.
members.speakLineZh: 謹慎填補缺失並報告。

members.senseAnchor: purported; commonly put forth or accepted as true on inconclusive grounds
members.speakLineEn: A putative mechanism needs a test.
members.speakLineZh: 據稱機制需要檢驗。

members.senseAnchor: someone authorized to exercise the powers of sheriff in emergencies; an assistant with power to act when his superior is absent
members.speakLineEn: Name a deputy data steward.
members.speakLineZh: 具名代理資料管家。

members.speakLineEn: A faster computer cannot fix bad design.
members.speakLineZh: 更快電腦修不好壞設計。

members.speakLineEn: Show computation steps for key figures.
members.speakLineZh: 關鍵圖顯示計算步驟。

members.speakLineEn: Disreputable vendors fail security review.
members.speakLineZh: 聲名狼藉廠商過不了資安審查。

members.senseAnchor: the state of being held in high esteem and honor; look on as or consider
members.speakLineEn: Repute is not a p-value.
members.speakLineZh: 名氣不是 p 值。

members.speakLineEn: Count exclusions before celebrating n.
members.speakLineZh: 慶祝樣本前先計數排除。

members.speakLineEn: Keep teams accountable for silent edits.
members.speakLineZh: 讓團隊對沉默修改可究責。

flow.content: 字根 put＝想、算——櫃門寫著：爭議、聲譽、計算、委派。

flow.content: quiz ×3

clusters.hook: 字根 qui＝靜——控制室專管安靜、靜止、默許與收購安靜。
clusters.script: quiet／quietly／quietude 靜音旋鈕。tranquil／tranquility 平靜畫面。acquiesce／acquiescent 默許點頭。requiem 安息曲梗；quietism 無為——控師：quietude for thinking；acquiesce to bad incentives 不行。

members.speakLineEn: Keep a quiet channel for error reports.
members.speakLineZh: 為錯誤回報保留安靜通道。

members.speakLineEn: Fix quietly, then announce publicly.
members.speakLineZh: 先安靜修好，再公開宣布。

members.speakLineEn: Protect quietude for reading the protocol.
members.speakLineZh: 保護閱讀規程的寧靜。

members.senseAnchor: (of a body of water) free from disturbance by heavy waves; not agitated; without losing self-possession
members.speakLineEn: Tranquil dashboards can hide missingness.
members.speakLineZh: 平靜儀表板可能藏缺失。

members.senseAnchor: a disposition free from stress or emotion; an untroubled state; free from disturbances
members.speakLineEn: Tranquility is not the same as rigor.
members.speakLineZh: 平靜不等於嚴謹。

members.speakLineEn: Do not acquiesce to outcome switching.
members.speakLineZh: 不要默許結局更換。

members.speakLineEn: An acquiescent coauthor still shares blame.
members.speakLineZh: 好說話共同作者仍共擔責任。

members.speakLineEn: Write a requiem for deprecated endpoints.
members.speakLineZh: 為棄用終點寫安魂曲。

members.speakLineEn: Quietism about misconduct enables it.
members.speakLineZh: 對不端的無為使其得逞。

members.speakLineEn: Mute hype words in the title.
members.speakLineZh: 標題靜音炒作詞。

members.senseAnchor: (poetic) tranquil silence; become quiet or still; fall silent
members.speakLineEn: Hush culture blocks whistleblowers.
members.speakLineZh: 噓聲文化阻擋吹哨。

clusters.script: inquisitive 愛追問；requisite 必要索取物。perquisite 額外津貼（perk）。inquisition 嚴厲審問。acquire 取得；relinquish 放手不求。exquisite 精緻到像精選求得；prerequisite 先決需求；conquistador 歷史上的征服求取者；query 發出查詢。
reviewHooks: requisite 必要 ≠ perquisite 額外津貼
pitfalls: requisite（必要條件）≠ perquisite（特權／津貼）

members.senseAnchor: improperly curious about the affairs of others
members.speakLineEn: Inquisitive reviewers catch silent exclusions.
members.speakLineZh: 好問審稿人抓到沉默排除。

members.senseAnchor: anything indispensable; necessary for relief or supply
members.speakLineEn: Statistical power is a requisite, not a luxury.
members.speakLineZh: 檢定力是必需，不是奢侈。

members.senseAnchor: an incidental benefit awarded for certain types of employment (especially if it is regarded as a right); a right reserved exclusively by a particular person or group (especially a hereditary or official right)
members.speakLineEn: Travel funds should not become a hidden perquisite.
members.speakLineZh: 差旅費不該變隱藏津貼。

members.speakLineEn: An ethics inquisition without due process backfires.
members.speakLineZh: 無正當程序的倫理審問會反噬。

members.speakLineEn: Acquire skills before acquiring expensive tools.
members.speakLineZh: 先習得技能再買昂貴工具。

members.speakLineEn: Relinquish control of randomization to a third party.
members.speakLineZh: 把隨機化控制交給第三方。

members.speakLineEn: Exquisite instruments still need dirty field tests.
members.speakLineZh: 精緻儀器仍需骯髒田野測試。

members.speakLineEn: Replication literacy is a prerequisite for meta-analysis.
members.speakLineZh: 複現素養是統合分析先決。

members.speakLineEn: Query the registry for unpublished trials.
members.speakLineZh: 向登錄庫查詢未發表試驗。

members.speakLineEn: The quest for significance warps designs.
members.speakLineZh: 追求顯著性會扭曲設計。

members.speakLineEn: Request raw data before accepting the narrative.
members.speakLineZh: 接受敘事前先請求原始資料。

members.speakLineEn: Open inquiry beats closed confirmation.
members.speakLineZh: 開放探究勝過封閉確認。

clusters.hook: 字根 radic＝根——園藝部專管根本、根除與生根。
clusters.script: radical／radically 連根改革。eradicate／eradication 根除雜草。radix／radicle／rootlet 根與幼根；rooted／rootedness／uprooting／deracinate——園長：eradicate p-hacking；radical openness。

members.speakLineEn: Radical transparency beats decorative openness.
members.speakLineZh: 根本透明勝過裝飾性開放。

members.speakLineEn: Radically rewrite incentives around corrections.
members.speakLineZh: 根本改寫圍繞勘誤的誘因。

members.speakLineEn: Eradicate silent outcome switching.
members.speakLineZh: 根除沉默結局更換。

members.speakLineEn: Eradication of opacity starts with logs.
members.speakLineZh: 根除不透明從日誌開始。

members.speakLineEn: Treat the estimand as the radix of claims.
members.speakLineZh: 把目標量當主張的根。

members.speakLineEn: Protect the radicle of junior skepticism.
members.speakLineZh: 保護資淺懷疑的幼根。

members.speakLineEn: Each rootlet of bias needs a label.
members.speakLineZh: 每條偏差細根都要標籤。

members.speakLineEn: Keep good habits rooted in checklists.
members.speakLineZh: 讓好習慣在清單中生根。

members.speakLineEn: Rootedness in methods beats charisma.
members.speakLineZh: 方法扎根勝過魅力。

members.speakLineEn: Uprooting legacy scripts needs a migration plan.
members.speakLineZh: 拔除遺留腳本需要遷移計畫。

members.speakLineEn: Deracinate cargo-cult statistics.
members.speakLineZh: 連根拔起盲從統計。

members.speakLineEn: Irradiate dark corners of the pipeline with audits.
members.speakLineZh: 用稽核照射管線暗角。

clusters.hook: 字根 rap/rav＝奪——警報台專管強奪、狂喜與蹂躪。
clusters.script: rapacious／rapacity 貪婪奪取。rapt／rapture／enrapture 奪魂狂喜。ravage／ravages／ravishing 蹂躪與奪目；usurp／plunder／seize——台長：rapacious metrics 禁；勿 usurp authorship。

members.senseAnchor: living by preying on other animals especially by catching living prey; excessively greedy and grasping
members.speakLineEn: Rapacious citation farming erodes trust.
members.speakLineZh: 貪婪刷引用侵蝕信任。

members.speakLineEn: Rapacity for significance invites fishing.
members.speakLineZh: 對顯著性的貪婪誘發淘篩。

members.speakLineEn: Stay rapt on the protocol, not the press.
members.speakLineZh: 全神貫注規程，不是新聞。

members.speakLineEn: Do not write abstracts in rapture without intervals.
members.speakLineZh: 摘要別在狂喜中省略區間。

members.speakLineEn: Flashy figures can enrapture and mislead.
members.speakLineZh: 炫圖能使人狂喜並誤導。

members.speakLineEn: Fraud will ravage a lab faster than a bug.
members.speakLineZh: 欺詐蹂躪實驗室比蟲快。

members.speakLineEn: Show the ravages of attrition in a flowchart.
members.speakLineZh: 用流程圖展示流失蹂躪。

members.senseAnchor: force (someone) to have sex against their will; hold spellbound
members.speakLineEn: A ravishing narrative is not identification.
members.speakLineZh: 奪目敘事不是識別策略。

members.speakLineEn: Do not usurp first authorship by stealth edits.
members.speakLineZh: 不要靠偷偷改稿篡奪一作。

members.senseAnchor: goods or money obtained illegally; take illegally; of intellectual property
members.speakLineEn: Plunder of shared data without credit is theft.
members.speakLineZh: 無署名掠奪共享資料是竊。

members.speakLineEn: Seize teaching moments when nulls appear.
members.speakLineZh: 虛無出現時抓住教學時刻。

clusters.hook: 字根 rect＝直、正——直尺局專管弄直、弄對、品德正直。
clusters.script: correct／rectify 用尺把錯線拉直。rectitude 品德也要直。erect 豎直立起；direct／indirect／directive 指路或轉彎指示。rectangle 直角邊框——局長章：先 rectify 方法，再 erect 結論大廈。

members.speakLineEn: Correct the record publicly.
members.speakLineZh: 公開改正紀錄。

members.senseAnchor: math: determine the length of; reduce to a fine, unmixed, or pure state; separate from extraneous matter or cleanse from impurities
members.speakLineEn: Rectify the codebook before round two.
members.speakLineZh: 第二輪前矯正碼本。

members.senseAnchor: righteousness as a consequence of being honorable and honest
members.speakLineEn: Rectitude matters more than cleverness.
members.speakLineZh: 正直比聰明重要。

members.speakLineEn: Do not erect causal towers on sand.
members.speakLineZh: 不要在沙上豎因果塔。

members.speakLineEn: Give direct answers about missingness.
members.speakLineZh: 對缺失給直接答案。

members.speakLineEn: Indirect effects need mediation assumptions.
members.speakLineZh: 間接效應需要中介假設。

members.speakLineEn: Follow the registry directive on outcomes.
members.speakLineZh: 遵循登錄庫對結局的指令。

members.speakLineEn: Put uncertainty in the rectangle of the figure.
members.speakLineZh: 把不確定放進圖的矩形裡。

members.speakLineEn: A timely correction is scholarship.
members.speakLineZh: 及時勘誤是學術。

members.speakLineEn: Mark incorrect claims without humiliation.
members.speakLineZh: 標記不正確主張但不羞辱。

members.speakLineEn: Straighten authorship order early.
members.speakLineZh: 及早弄直作者序。

members.speakLineEn: Stay upright when incentives bend.
members.speakLineZh: 誘因彎曲時仍站直。

clusters.hook: 字根 reg/rex＝統治——調度室專管國王、攝政、體制與規則。
clusters.script: regal 王者氣場；regent 攝政代班。regime 統治體制；regicide 弒君大戲。regulate／regular 用規則排班；interregnum 王位空窗期——大臣諫言：科學要 regulate，不要 regicide 式互砍。
pitfalls: regime 可指政權或制度／養生制度

members.speakLineEn: Regal prose cannot hide weak n.
members.speakLineZh: 帝王文風藏不住弱樣本。

members.speakLineEn: An interim regent should not rewrite norms alone.
members.speakLineZh: 臨時攝政不該獨改規範。

members.speakLineEn: A data-sharing regime needs enforcement.
members.speakLineZh: 資料共享體制需要執行。

members.speakLineEn: Methodological 'regicide' of sacred cows needs evidence.
members.speakLineZh: 對聖牛的方法弒君需要證據。

members.speakLineEn: Regulate access to identifiable data.
members.speakLineZh: 管制可識別資料近用。

members.speakLineEn: Run regular audits of repositories.
members.speakLineZh: 定期稽核儲庫。

members.speakLineEn: During an interregnum, freeze risky protocol changes.
members.speakLineZh: 空位期凍結高風險規程變更。

members.speakLineEn: Follow human-subjects regulation closely.
members.speakLineZh: 嚴格遵守人體研究法規。

members.speakLineEn: Be a ruler of processes, not of people by fear.
members.speakLineZh: 用流程統治，不用恐懼統治人。

members.speakLineEn: During her reign as editor, open data rose.
members.speakLineZh: 她任編輯期間開放資料上升。

members.speakLineEn: No lab is sovereign over ethics boards.
members.speakLineZh: 沒有實驗室對倫理委員會擁有主權。

members.speakLineEn: Govern incentives, not only individuals.
members.speakLineZh: 治理誘因，不只治理個人。

clusters.hook: 字根 rid/ris＝笑——露天劇場專管好笑、可笑、被笑。
clusters.script: ridicule／derision 把人笑下場。ridiculous 荒謬到全場笑；risible 可笑的劇本。absurd 荒誕到笑不出；mockery 嘲弄加演——主持人喊卡：可以 ridicule 爛設計，不要 ridicule 人。

members.speakLineEn: Ridicule bad incentives, not junior mistakes made in good faith.
members.speakLineZh: 嘲笑壞誘因，而非善意資淺錯誤。

members.speakLineEn: A ridiculous sample size claim needs pushback.
members.speakLineZh: 荒謬樣本宣稱需要反推。

members.speakLineEn: The excuse was risible under audit.
members.speakLineZh: 稽核下那個藉口可笑。

members.speakLineEn: Public derision is not peer review.
members.speakLineZh: 公開嘲弄不是同儕審查。

members.speakLineEn: It is absurd to equate p<.05 with truth.
members.speakLineZh: 把 p<.05 當真理很荒謬。

members.speakLineEn: A mockery of preregistration is worse than none.
members.speakLineZh: 拙劣模仿預註冊比沒有更糟。

members.speakLineEn: Laughable robustness checks fool no one.
members.speakLineZh: 可笑的穩健檢查騙不了人。

members.speakLineEn: Keep comic relief out of the limitations section.
members.speakLineZh: 限制段別放喜劇調劑。

members.speakLineEn: Irony about open science still needs open code.
members.speakLineZh: 諷刺開放科學仍需開放程式碼。

members.senseAnchor: witty language used to convey insults or scorn; ; ; --Jonathan Swift
members.speakLineEn: Satire can teach norms; data still decide.
members.speakLineZh: 諷刺能教規範；資料仍裁決。

members.senseAnchor: showing your contempt by derision; laugh at with contempt and derision
members.speakLineEn: Jeers at null results chill honesty.
members.speakLineZh: 對虛無結果起哄寒蟬誠實。

members.senseAnchor: showing your contempt by derision; laugh at with contempt and derision
members.speakLineEn: Scoff less; specify more.
members.speakLineZh: 少嗤笑；多具體。

clusters.script: interrogate 問到水落石出。arrogant／arrogance 還沒問就自以為知道。prerogative 特權提問權；derogatory 貶低式問話。abrogate 廢止條款；arrogate 擅自據為己有——警衛：interrogation 對方法，arrogance 對人零分。

members.senseAnchor: transmit (a signal) for setting off an appropriate response, as in telecommunication; pose a series of questions to
members.speakLineEn: Interrogate the identification assumptions.
members.speakLineZh: 質詢識別假設。

members.speakLineEn: Arrogance about nulls wastes cohorts.
members.speakLineZh: 對虛無的傲慢浪費世代。

members.senseAnchor: an exclusive or special right, power, or privilege
members.speakLineEn: Gatekeeping is not an editor's prerogative forever.
members.speakLineZh: 把關不是編輯永久特權。

members.speakLineEn: Avoid derogatory labels for honest errors.
members.speakLineZh: 對誠實錯誤避免貶損標籤。

members.speakLineEn: Abrogate incentives that punish sharing.
members.speakLineZh: 廢止懲罰共享的誘因。

members.speakLineEn: Do not arrogate credit for others' code.
members.speakLineZh: 不要僭取他人程式碼功勞。

members.senseAnchor: a sentence of inquiry that asks for a reply; a transmission that will trigger an answering transmission from a transponder
members.speakLineEn: Friendly interrogation of figures helps.
members.speakLineZh: 友善質詢圖表有幫助。

members.senseAnchor: someone who takes the place of another person; a person appointed to represent or act on behalf of others
members.speakLineEn: Use a surrogate endpoint only with justification.
members.speakLineZh: 僅在有理由時用替代終點。

members.speakLineEn: Question every silent default.
members.speakLineZh: 質問每個沉默預設。

members.senseAnchor: a heavy iron lever with one end forged into a wedge; to move or force, especially in an effort to get something open; :
members.speakLineEn: Do not pry into identifiable free text casually.
members.speakLineZh: 不要隨便打探可識別自由文本。

members.speakLineEn: Ask for raw data politely and persistently.
members.speakLineZh: 禮貌且持續地索取原始資料。

clusters.hook: 字根 rupt＝破——哪裡一響，哪裡就裂。
clusters.script: 談判 abrupt 突然中斷；制度 corrupt 從內部破爛。抗議 disrupt 打亂秩序，火山 erupt 噴出。bankrupt 破產，rupture 是裂口；interrupt 从中打斷，irrupt 衝破闖入。
reviewHooks: rupt＝破：abrupt 驟斷、corrupt 內爛、disrupt 打亂、erupt 噴出
bankrupt＝銀行／帳面破裂；rupture＝裂口本身
pitfalls: abrupt 指突然，不一定負面，但常帶生硬感
corrupt 可作形容詞或動詞

members.speakLineEn: An abrupt transition confused the audience.
members.speakLineZh: 突然的轉折讓聽眾困惑。

members.speakLineEn: Corrupt incentives distort measurement.
members.speakLineZh: 腐敗誘因扭曲測量。

members.speakLineEn: New tools disrupt old workflows—and old hierarchies.
members.speakLineZh: 新工具擾亂舊流程——以及舊階層。

members.senseAnchor: start abruptly; erupt or intensify suddenly
members.speakLineEn: Controversy erupted after the leak.
members.speakLineZh: 洩漏後爭議爆發。

members.speakLineEn: The theory is morally bankrupt if it excuses harm.
members.speakLineZh: 若為傷害開脫，該理論在道德上已破產。

members.senseAnchor: state of being torn or burst open; a personal or social separation (as between opposing factions)
members.speakLineEn: A rupture between method and claim is fatal.
members.speakLineZh: 方法與主張之間的裂口是致命的。

members.speakLineEn: Please do not interrupt the operational definition.
members.speakLineZh: 請不要打斷操作型定義。

members.speakLineEn: An irruption of cases overwhelmed the clinic model.
members.speakLineZh: 病例突然湧入壓垮了診所模型。

members.speakLineEn: The eruption of outrage was predictable.
members.speakLineZh: 憤怒的爆發其實可預期。

members.speakLineEn: Data corruption invalidated the third trial.
members.speakLineZh: 資料損壞使第三次試驗無效。

members.speakLineEn: Disruptive claims need stronger evidence, not louder ads.
members.speakLineZh: 顛覆式宣稱需要更強證據，而非更大聲廣告。

bankrupt＝銀行／帳面破裂；rupture＝裂口本身

clusters.hook: 字根 sacr/sanct＝聖——保全署把「不可碰」的東西貼封印，也抓假虔誠。
clusters.script: sacred／sacrosanct 貼上聖封。sanctuary／sanctify／saint 庇護所與封聖儀式。sacrifice／sacrificial 獻祭交換；sanction／sanctimonious／consecrate 制裁、假神聖、奉獻——署長：methods 可 sacred；ego 不可 sacrosanct。

members.speakLineEn: Treat consent as sacred, not optional.
members.speakLineZh: 把同意視為神聖，不是可選。

members.speakLineEn: No hypothesis is sacrosanct after new evidence.
members.speakLineZh: 新證據後沒有假說不可碰。

members.senseAnchor: a consecrated place where sacred objects are kept; a shelter from danger or hardship
members.speakLineEn: Make the lab a sanctuary for honest doubt.
members.speakLineZh: 讓實驗室成為誠實懷疑的庇護所。

members.speakLineEn: Do not sanctify a pipeline just because it is old.
members.speakLineZh: 別因老舊就封聖一條管線。

members.speakLineEn: Never sacrifice blinding for speed.
members.speakLineZh: 永遠不要為速度犧牲盲法。

members.speakLineEn: Juniors are not sacrificial authors.
members.speakLineZh: 資淺者不是祭品作者。

members.speakLineEn: Ethics boards sanction protocols, not vibes.
members.speakLineZh: 倫理委員會批准規程，不是感覺。

members.senseAnchor: appoint to a clerical posts; give entirely to a specific person, activity, or cause
members.speakLineEn: Consecrate time for replication, not only novelty.
members.speakLineZh: 把時間奉獻給複現，不只新奇。

members.speakLineEn: Even a methods saint needs checklists.
members.speakLineZh: 方法聖人仍需要清單。

members.senseAnchor: pretending to be morally better than other people
members.speakLineEn: Sanctimonious slogans do not replace audits.
members.speakLineZh: 假虔誠口號取代不了稽核。

members.speakLineEn: Keep a holy distance from unblinded peeks.
members.speakLineZh: 與非盲偷看保持神聖距離。

members.senseAnchor: a prejudice (especially in Polynesia and other South Pacific islands) that prohibits the use or mention of something because of its sacred nature; an inhibition or ban resulting from social custom or emotional aversion
members.speakLineEn: Make outcome switching a lab taboo.
members.speakLineZh: 把結局替換設為實驗室禁忌。

clusters.hook: 字根 sal/sult＝跳——諮詢台專管跳出重點、跳去罵人、彈回來。
clusters.script: salient 跳出刺點；sally 衝出去一輪。insult／assail／assault 跳過來攻擊。result／consult／consultant 跳回結果與顧問；resilient／desultory／exult 彈回、跳來跳去、歡躍——台長：salient findings 要報；desultory fishing 禁。

members.senseAnchor: (military) the part of the line of battle that projects closest to the enemy; having a quality that thrusts itself into attention
members.speakLineEn: Report the salient threat to validity first.
members.speakLineZh: 先報告最突出的效度威脅。

members.speakLineEn: One exploratory sally needs a clear label.
members.speakLineZh: 一次探索突襲需要清楚標籤。

members.speakLineEn: Do not insult reviewers with hidden exclusions.
members.speakLineZh: 別用隱藏排除侮辱審稿人。

members.speakLineEn: Assail weak designs, not people.
members.speakLineZh: 抨擊虛弱設計，不是抨擊人。

members.speakLineEn: An assault on p-hacking starts with templates.
members.speakLineZh: 打擊 p 值黑客從模板開始。

members.speakLineEn: Lock the result definition before looking.
members.speakLineZh: 看之前先鎖定結果定義。

members.speakLineEn: Consult a statistician before clever tricks.
members.speakLineZh: 耍聰明前先諮詢統計師。

members.speakLineEn: A consultant cannot replace your prereg.
members.speakLineZh: 顧問取代不了你的預註冊。

members.senseAnchor: recovering readily from adversity, depression, or the like; elastic; rebounds readily
members.speakLineEn: Build resilient pipelines with tests.
members.speakLineZh: 用測試打造有韌性的管線。

members.senseAnchor: the physical property of a material that can return to its original shape or position after deformation that does not exceed its elastic limit; an occurrence of rebounding or springing back
members.speakLineEn: Resilience includes recovering from nulls.
members.speakLineZh: 韌性包含從虛無中恢復。

members.senseAnchor: lacking a definite plan, purpose, or pattern
members.speakLineEn: Desultory analyses look like fishing.
members.speakLineZh: 雜亂分析看起來像淘篩。

members.senseAnchor: feel extreme happiness or elation; to express great joy
members.speakLineEn: Exult after replication, not after one peek.
members.speakLineZh: 複現後再歡躍，不是偷看後。

clusters.hook: 字根 sat/satis＝滿——餐廳專管滿足、飽和、過剩與資產。
clusters.script: satisfy／satisfaction／satisfactory 上菜滿意度。sate／satiate／satiated 吃到飽。saturate／saturation／saturated 醬汁飽和。asset／satire 資產與諷刺配菜——主廚：satisfactory power；不要 saturate 摘要形容詞。

members.speakLineEn: Satisfy reviewers with robustness, not adjectives.
members.speakLineZh: 用穩健滿足審稿，不是形容詞。

members.speakLineEn: Reader satisfaction tracks clarity of estimands.
members.speakLineZh: 讀者滿意追蹤目標量清晰度。

members.speakLineEn: A satisfactory prereg is specific.
members.speakLineZh: 令人滿意的預註冊要具體。

members.speakLineEn: Sate curiosity with exploratory labels.
members.speakLineZh: 用探索標籤滿足好奇。

members.speakLineEn: Do not satiate journals with recycled figures.
members.speakLineZh: 不要用回收圖灌飽期刊。

members.senseAnchor: fill to satisfaction; overeat or eat immodestly; make a pig of oneself
members.speakLineEn: A satiated alpha leaves nothing for confirmation.
members.speakLineZh: α 吃飽就沒剩確認額度。

members.speakLineEn: Do not saturate the abstract with hype.
members.speakLineZh: 不要用炒作使摘要飽和。

members.speakLineEn: Market saturation of flashy claims hurts trust.
members.speakLineZh: 炫目主張市場飽和傷害信任。

members.speakLineEn: A saturated model still needs out-of-sample checks.
members.speakLineZh: 飽和模型仍需樣本外檢查。

members.speakLineEn: Open code is a lab asset.
members.speakLineZh: 開放程式碼是實驗室資產。

members.speakLineEn: Enough power beats elegant underpower.
members.speakLineZh: 足夠檢定力勝過優雅的不足。

clusters.script: 英雄 ascend 上升，反派 descend 下降；真正高手 transcend 超越階層。最討厭的是 condescend：假裝屈尊下爬來『關心』你。音樂一 crescendo，情緒也往上爬。

condescend 必帶『高人一等』語氣
pitfalls: descend into = 墮落到某種壞狀態
crescendo 常被誤用為『高潮本身』，嚴格說是『漸強過程』

members.speakLineEn: She ascended to leadership after the crisis.
members.speakLineZh: 危機後她上升到領導位置。

members.speakLineEn: The debate descended into personal attacks.
members.speakLineZh: 辯論墮落到人身攻擊。

members.senseAnchor: be greater in scope or size than some standard; be superior or better than some standard
members.speakLineEn: Great art can transcend its historical moment.
members.speakLineZh: 偉大藝術能超越其歷史時刻。

members.speakLineEn: Do not condescend to readers with oversimplified claims.
members.speakLineZh: 別用過度簡化的說法屈尊俯就讀者。

members.senseAnchor: (music) a gradual increase in loudness; grow louder
members.speakLineEn: Criticism rose to a crescendo before the vote.
members.speakLineZh: 投票前批評聲浪漸強至高潮。

clusters.hook: 字根 sci＝知——觀測台專管「知道／良知」。
clusters.script: science 系統之知；conscious 有意識知道。conscience 良心那盞燈；omniscient 全知。prescient 預先知道；nescient／nescience 無知。plebiscite 全民表決像集體表態所知；unconscionable 違背良心到不可接受。
reviewHooks: conscious 意識 ≠ conscience 良心

members.speakLineEn: Science advances by correcting itself.
members.speakLineZh: 科學靠自我校正前進。

members.speakLineEn: Be conscious of researcher degrees of freedom.
members.speakLineZh: 要意識到研究者自由度。

members.speakLineEn: A researcher's conscience should stop p-hacking.
members.speakLineZh: 研究者良心應阻止 p 值操弄。

members.senseAnchor: possessed of universal or complete knowledge
members.speakLineEn: No reviewer is omniscient across fields.
members.speakLineZh: 沒有審稿人跨領域全知。

members.senseAnchor: able to know what will happen in the future
members.speakLineEn: Her prescient warning about overfitting aged well.
members.speakLineZh: 她對過度擬合的先見經得起時間。

members.speakLineEn: Admit nescience rather than invent certainty.
members.speakLineZh: 承認無知勝過捏造確定。

members.speakLineEn: A plebiscite cannot replace technical review.
members.speakLineZh: 公投不能取代技術審查。

members.senseAnchor: lacking a conscience; greatly exceeding bounds of reason or moderation
members.speakLineEn: Withholding adverse results is unconscionable.
members.speakLineZh: 隱瞞不良結果良心難安。

members.zhGloss: 不自在的；自我意識強的
members.senseAnchor: 不自在的；自我意識強的
members.speakLineEn: Self-conscious prose hides weak claims.
members.speakLineZh: 扭捏文風常掩蓋弱主張。

members.speakLineEn: Subconscious cues still need controlled tests.
members.speakLineZh: 潛意識線索仍需對照試驗。

members.speakLineEn: Claims of omniscience belong to theology, not labs.
members.speakLineZh: 全知宣稱屬神學不屬實驗室。

members.speakLineEn: Scientific humility includes reporting limits.
members.speakLineZh: 科學謙遜包含報告限制。

clusters.hook: 字根 scop＝看——望遠鏡館專管範圍、窺視與各種 -scope。
clusters.script: scope 視野範圍。telescope 看遠；microscope 看小；periscope 抬頭偷看。horoscope 星象娛樂（別當證據）。episcope／scope creep：範圍蔓延——館長：先定 scope，再防 scope creep；horoscope 請離開方法段。

members.speakLineEn: Define the scope of claims narrowly.
members.speakLineZh: 把主張範圍定窄一點。

members.speakLineEn: Do not telescope years of work into one lucky p.
members.speakLineZh: 不要把多年工作壓縮成一次幸運 p。

members.speakLineEn: Put the codebook under a microscope.
members.speakLineZh: 把碼本放顯微鏡下。

members.speakLineEn: A periscope peek at interim results biases stopping.
members.speakLineZh: 潛望鏡偷看期中結果扭曲停損。

members.speakLineEn: A horoscope is not a causal identification.
members.speakLineZh: 星座運勢不是因果識別。

members.speakLineEn: Fight scope creep with written aims.
members.speakLineZh: 用書面目標對抗範圍蔓延。

members.speakLineEn: A kaleidoscope of metrics confuses policy.
members.speakLineZh: 指標萬花筒迷惑政策。

members.speakLineEn: Endoscope the pipeline for silent forks.
members.speakLineZh: 用內視鏡檢查管線沉默分叉。

members.speakLineEn: Scopophilia jokes aside: respect participant privacy.
members.speakLineZh: 窺視玩笑之外：尊重參與者隱私。

members.speakLineEn: Overscope claims invite reviewer fire.
members.speakLineZh: 主張過寬招來審稿砲火。

members.speakLineEn: Narrow the estimand before modeling.
members.speakLineZh: 建模前先縮窄目標量。

members.speakLineEn: Give a sober outlook in discussion.
members.speakLineZh: 討論給清醒展望。

clusters.hook: 字根 scrib/script＝寫——誰寫進去，誰被寫出去。
clusters.script: describe 描寫，inscribe 刻寫進去，proscribe 明文禁止，prescribe 開處方／規定。script 劇本，manuscript 手稿，subscribe 署名訂閱，transcribe 轉寫，ascribe 歸因寫到誰頭上，circumscribe 劃界限制，scribble 亂寫，conscript 徵召寫入名單，postscript 又及。
pitfalls: ascribe X to Y＝把 X 歸因於 Y

members.speakLineEn: Describe the sampling frame before results.
members.speakLineZh: 結果前先描述抽樣架構。

members.speakLineEn: Values inscribed in charters need operational teeth.
members.speakLineZh: 憲章銘刻的價值需要可操作牙齒。

members.speakLineEn: The code proscribes dual submission.
members.speakLineZh: 規範禁止一稿兩投。

members.senseAnchor: say what medicine or treatment a sick person should have
members.speakLineEn: Guidelines prescribe reporting confidence intervals.
members.speakLineZh: 指引規定報告信賴區間。

members.speakLineEn: Preregistration is a script against flexible plotting.
members.speakLineZh: 預註冊是對抗彈性畫圖的腳本。

members.speakLineEn: The manuscript should flag all deviations.
members.speakLineZh: 手稿應標明所有偏離。

members.speakLineEn: I cannot subscribe to that causal leap.
members.speakLineZh: 我無法附和那因果跳躍。

members.senseAnchor: write out from speech, notes, etc.; rewrite in a different script
members.speakLineEn: Transcribe interviews with speaker labels.
members.speakLineZh: 訪談轉寫請標說話者。

members.speakLineEn: Do not ascribe intent without evidence.
members.speakLineZh: 無證據不要歸因意圖。

members.speakLineEn: Budget rules circumscribe feasible designs.
members.speakLineZh: 預算規則限制可行設計。

members.speakLineEn: Margin scribbles are not a codebook.
members.speakLineZh: 頁邊亂寫不是編碼簿。

members.senseAnchor: someone who is drafted into military service; enroll into service compulsorily
members.speakLineEn: Do not conscript unrelated citations for decoration.
members.speakLineZh: 不要強徵無關引用當裝飾。

members.speakLineEn: A postscript cannot fix a broken identification strategy.
members.speakLineZh: 又及救不了壞的識別策略。

members.speakLineEn: A nondescript method section hides key choices.
members.speakLineZh: 平淡方法段會藏起關鍵選擇。

members.speakLineEn: Check superscripts in chemical and statistical notation.
members.speakLineZh: 檢查化學與統計記號上標。

members.speakLineEn: Public sector data still needs consent maps.
members.speakLineZh: 公共部門資料仍需同意地圖。

members.speakLineEn: A methods dissection belongs in supplements.
members.speakLineZh: 方法解剖屬於補充材料。

members.speakLineEn: Bug trackers catch insects before reviewers do.
members.speakLineZh: 錯誤追蹤器比審稿人先抓蟲。

members.speakLineEn: Where ethics and methods intersect, document both.
members.speakLineZh: 倫理與方法相交處兩者都記錄。

members.speakLineEn: Study the intersection of missingness and attrition.
members.speakLineZh: 研究缺失與流失的交集。

members.speakLineEn: Bisect the sample only if pre-planned.
members.speakLineZh: 僅在預先計畫時對切樣本。

members.speakLineEn: A secant through subgroups needs correction.
members.speakLineZh: 割過次群需要校正。

members.speakLineEn: Transect the city with random routes, not vibes.
members.speakLineZh: 用隨機路線橫切城市，不是感覺。

members.speakLineEn: Show a cutaway of the pipeline stages.
members.speakLineZh: 展示管線階段剖面。

members.speakLineEn: Predefine segments before looking at outcomes.
members.speakLineZh: 看結局前先定義區段。

clusters.script: sedentary 久坐；sediment 沉下去的渣。reside 住下，president 坐主位。session 一次開會坐下；obsess 坐著不放。assiduous 勤坐苦幹；insidious 潛伏坐下害人。subsidiary 附屬坐下幫忙；dissident 不肯同坐一席的異議者。

members.speakLineEn: Sedentary designs miss real-world motion noise.
members.speakLineZh: 久坐式設計錯過真實移動噪音。

members.speakLineEn: Policy sediment accumulates from old rules.
members.speakLineZh: 舊規累積成政策沉澱。

members.speakLineEn: Authority should reside in transparent criteria.
members.speakLineZh: 權威應存在於透明標準。

members.speakLineEn: The society president disclosed funding ties.
members.speakLineZh: 學會主席揭露資助關係。

members.speakLineEn: Each coding session used a blinded codebook.
members.speakLineZh: 每次編碼時段使用盲法碼本。

members.speakLineEn: Do not obsess over a single p-threshold.
members.speakLineZh: 不要執念單一 p 門檻。

members.speakLineEn: Assiduous documentation prevents silent edits.
members.speakLineZh: 勤勉記錄防止沉默修改。

members.senseAnchor: causing harm in a way that is gradual or not easily noticed
members.speakLineEn: Insidious selection bias grows with convenience samples.
members.speakLineZh: 陰險選擇偏差隨便利樣本成長。

members.senseAnchor: an assistant subject to the authority or control of another; a company that is completely controlled by another company
members.speakLineEn: Report subsidiary analyses as exploratory.
members.speakLineZh: 附屬分析標為探索性。

members.senseAnchor: a person who dissents from some established policy; characterized by departure from accepted beliefs or standards
members.speakLineEn: Dissident findings deserve the same review rigor.
members.speakLineZh: 異議發現值得同等審查嚴謹。

members.speakLineEn: The error may reside in measurement, not theory.
members.speakLineZh: 錯誤可能在測量不在理論。

members.speakLineEn: An obsession with novelty crowds out replication.
members.speakLineZh: 嗜新執念排擠複現。

clusters.hook: 字根 sem/semin＝種——散播站專管播種、研討與「種子級」影響。
clusters.script: seminar／seminary 研討溫室。seminal 種子級論文。disseminate／dissemination 把種子撒出去；inseminate／seed／seedling 播入與幼苗——站長：disseminate nulls；seminal 不是自封。

members.speakLineEn: Bring raw plots to the seminar, not vibes.
members.speakLineZh: 研討會帶原始圖，不是感覺。

members.speakLineEn: Treat lab training like a methods seminary.
members.speakLineZh: 把實驗室訓練當方法養成所。

members.speakLineEn: Call a paper seminal only after replication.
members.speakLineZh: 複現後才稱論文開創。

members.speakLineEn: Disseminate protocols with the preprint.
members.speakLineZh: 與預印本一起散播規程。

members.speakLineEn: Plan dissemination of negatives too.
members.speakLineZh: 負結果也要有散播計畫。

members.speakLineEn: Inseminate good habits in onboarding week.
members.speakLineZh: 入職週就播入好習慣。

members.speakLineEn: Set a random seed and record it.
members.speakLineZh: 設定隨機種子並記錄。

members.speakLineEn: Protect seedling ideas from hype frost.
members.speakLineZh: 保護幼苗想法免於炒作霜凍。

members.speakLineEn: Sow preregistration before collecting.
members.speakLineZh: 收集前先播下預註冊。

members.speakLineEn: Let critiques germinate before rebutting.
members.speakLineZh: 反駁前讓批評先發芽。

members.senseAnchor: a haphazard distribution in all directions; the act of scattering
members.speakLineEn: Scatterplots beat adjective storms.
members.speakLineZh: 散佈圖勝過形容詞風暴。

members.speakLineEn: Broadcast corrections as loudly as launches.
members.speakLineZh: 勘誤廣播要跟上線一樣大聲。

clusters.hook: 字根 sent/sens＝感、意見——議會裡大家『覺得』與『同意』。
clusters.script: sentiment 情緒意見；assent 同意，dissent 已在 look 族——這裡補 consent 同意／許可。sense 感官／意義，sensible 明智，sensitive 敏感，sensory 感官的。resent 憤恨，presentiment 預感，sentinel 哨兵，consensus 共識，sensational 聳動。
pitfalls: assent/dissent 已在 look-a-01，本族重 consent／consensus

members.speakLineEn: Policy should not track online sentiment alone.
members.speakLineZh: 政策不該只追網路情緒。

members.speakLineEn: Document consent before data linkage.
members.speakLineZh: 資料連結前記錄同意。

members.speakLineEn: Does this operationalization make sense theoretically?
members.speakLineZh: 此操作化理論上說得通嗎？

members.speakLineEn: A sensible robustness check is cheap insurance.
members.speakLineZh: 明智穩健檢查是便宜保險。

members.speakLineEn: Results are sensitive to one influential point.
members.speakLineZh: 結果對一個影響點敏感。

members.speakLineEn: Sensory overload in dashboards hides the signal.
members.speakLineZh: 儀表板感官過載會藏訊號。

members.senseAnchor: feel bitter or indignant about; wish ill or allow unwillingly
members.speakLineEn: Teams resent uncredited labor on shared datasets.
members.speakLineZh: 團隊憤恨共享資料上未記名勞動。

members.senseAnchor: a feeling of evil to come
members.speakLineEn: A presentiment of failure is not a stopping rule.
members.speakLineZh: 失敗預感不是停止規則。

members.senseAnchor: a person employed to keep watch for some anticipated event
members.speakLineEn: Sentinel sites detect outbreaks early.
members.speakLineZh: 哨兵站點及早偵測疫情。

members.speakLineEn: Consensus can lag behind better evidence.
members.speakLineZh: 共識可能落後更好證據。

members.senseAnchor: intended to interest, excite, or shock people
members.speakLineEn: Sensational abstracts travel farther than careful ones.
members.speakLineZh: 聳動摘要比謹慎摘要傳更遠。

members.speakLineEn: Call speculation nonsense when it wears a proof costume.
members.speakLineZh: 投機穿上證明外衣時就叫它胡說。

members.speakLineEn: Repeated crises can desensitize audiences to risk.
members.speakLineZh: 反覆危機使觀眾對風險不敏感。

members.speakLineEn: Unpaid reviewing breeds resentment.
members.speakLineZh: 無酬審稿滋生怨恨。

members.speakLineEn: Extrasensory claims need extraordinary tests.
members.speakLineZh: 超感官宣稱需要非凡檢驗。

clusters.hook: 字根 sequ＝跟隨——追擊隊專管誰跟在誰後面。
clusters.script: sequence 順序跟著；consequence 跟著來的後果。subsequent 隨後；consecutive 連續跟著。prosecute 依法追擊，persecute 無理追打。obsequious 諂媚跟太緊；execute 執行跟上命令。segue 平滑接下一段；non sequitur 跟不上邏輯的句子。
reviewHooks: prosecute 檢控 ≠ persecute 迫害

members.speakLineEn: Report the analysis sequence before peeking.
members.speakLineZh: 偷看前先報告分析序列。

members.speakLineEn: Underpowered studies have scientific consequence.
members.speakLineZh: 檢定力不足有科學後果。

members.speakLineEn: Subsequent replications failed to confirm.
members.speakLineZh: 隨後複現未能確認。

members.speakLineEn: Three consecutive nulls lowered confidence.
members.speakLineZh: 連續三次虛無降低信心。

members.senseAnchor: conduct a prosecution in a court of law; bring a criminal action against (in a trial)
members.speakLineEn: Agencies can prosecute data fraud.
members.speakLineZh: 機關可起訴資料詐欺。

members.speakLineEn: Do not persecute whistleblowers.
members.speakLineZh: 不要迫害吹哨者。

members.senseAnchor: attempting to win favor from influential people by flattery; attentive in an ingratiating or servile manner
members.speakLineEn: Obsequious citing of celebrities weakens peer review.
members.speakLineZh: 諂媚引用名人削弱同儕審查。

members.speakLineEn: Execute the preregistered plan without silent swaps.
members.speakLineZh: 執行預註冊計畫、勿沉默替換。

members.speakLineEn: Segue from methods to limits without hype.
members.speakLineZh: 從方法平滑接到限制，勿炒作。

members.speakLineEn: That slogan is a policy non sequitur.
members.speakLineZh: 那句口號是政策上的不接邏輯。

members.speakLineEn: Use sequential analysis only with alpha spending.
members.speakLineZh: 序列分析須配合 α 消耗。

members.speakLineEn: Blind pursuit of significance wastes cohorts.
members.speakLineZh: 盲目追求顯著性浪費世代。

clusters.hook: 字根 serv＝侍、守——服務站專管保存、觀察、應得與順服。
clusters.script: conserve／preserve 把油存好。observe／observation／observant 觀察加油燈。deserve 應得幾格油；subservient 過度順服客人。service／servant／reservation：服務、侍者、預約保留——站長：observe 資料，preserve 原始檔，別 subservient 到不敢報錯。
pitfalls: conserve≈preserve 略有分工：保育／保存

members.speakLineEn: Conserve statistical power with better design.
members.speakLineZh: 用更好設計保存檢定力。

members.speakLineEn: Preserve raw files immutable.
members.speakLineZh: 原始檔不可變地保存。

members.speakLineEn: Observe the preregistered plan.
members.speakLineZh: 遵守預註冊計畫。

members.speakLineEn: An observation is not a causal claim.
members.speakLineZh: 觀察不是因果主張。

members.speakLineEn: Observant reviewers catch silent swaps.
members.speakLineZh: 眼尖審稿人抓到沉默替換。

members.speakLineEn: Null results deserve space.
members.speakLineZh: 虛無結果應得版面。

members.senseAnchor: compliant and obedient to authority; -G. B. Shaw; serving or acting as a means or aid
members.speakLineEn: Do not be subservient to fashion metrics.
members.speakLineZh: 不要屈從流行指標。

members.speakLineEn: State reservations about external validity.
members.speakLineZh: 陳述對外部效度的保留。

members.speakLineEn: Treat data service as scholarship.
members.speakLineZh: 把資料服務當學術。

members.speakLineEn: Conserve evidence trails for audits.
members.speakLineZh: 為稽核保存證據軌跡。

members.speakLineEn: Participants deserve better consent UX.
members.speakLineZh: 參與者應得更好的同意體驗。

members.speakLineEn: Lock down the server before sharing IDs.
members.speakLineZh: 共享 ID 前鎖好伺服器。

clusters.hook: 字根 sign＝記號——信號站專管簽名、指派、設計與意義。
clusters.script: sign 簽名放行。signal／significance 信號與顯著小旗。assign／designate 指派崗位。design 畫出藍圖；resign 簽名離職。insignificant 小到沒旗；consign 託運記號——站長：significance ≠ importance；先 design 再 sign。

members.speakLineEn: Sign the conflict disclosure.
members.speakLineZh: 簽署利益衝突揭露。

members.speakLineEn: Separate signal from noise with prereg.
members.speakLineZh: 用預註冊分離信號與噪音。

members.speakLineEn: Statistical significance is not practical importance.
members.speakLineZh: 統計顯著不是實務重要。

members.speakLineEn: Assign blinding roles before randomization.
members.speakLineZh: 隨機化前指派盲法角色。

members.speakLineEn: Designate primary outcomes in writing.
members.speakLineZh: 書面指定主要結局。

members.speakLineEn: Design for missingness, not only for means.
members.speakLineZh: 為缺失設計，不只為均值。

members.speakLineEn: Resign from vanity metrics.
members.speakLineZh: 辭去虛榮指標。

members.speakLineEn: An insignificant p is still information.
members.speakLineZh: 不顯著 p 仍是資訊。

members.senseAnchor: commit forever; commit irrevocably; give over to another for care or safekeeping
members.speakLineEn: Do not consign ethics to an afterthought.
members.speakLineZh: 不要把倫理託付給事後想法。

members.speakLineEn: Fraud often leaves a signature pattern.
members.speakLineZh: 造假常留下特徵模式。

members.speakLineEn: Signpost limitations early.
members.speakLineZh: 及早設置限制路標。

members.speakLineEn: Cosign only what you verified.
members.speakLineZh: 只連署你驗證過的。

clusters.hook: 字根 simil/simul＝相似——影棚專管相像、同時、假裝與彙整。
clusters.script: similar／similarity 長得很像。simulate／simulation 用替身拍危險戲。simultaneous 多機同時開拍。assimilate 把新人同化進劇組；facsimile 傳真複本；dissimilar 根本不是同一劇——導演：simulate 可以，假資料不行；facsimile ≠ 原始檔。

members.speakLineEn: Similar p-values do not imply same mechanisms.
members.speakLineZh: 相似 p 值不代表同一機制。

members.speakLineEn: Report similarity metrics with caveats.
members.speakLineZh: 報告相似性指標並附但書。

members.speakLineEn: Simulate missingness before claiming robustness.
members.speakLineZh: 宣稱穩健前先模擬缺失。

members.speakLineEn: A simulation is not a substitute for field data alone.
members.speakLineZh: 模擬不能單獨取代田野資料。

members.speakLineEn: Avoid simultaneous unblinded peeks.
members.speakLineZh: 避免同時非盲偷看。

members.speakLineEn: Assimilate open norms without erasing dissent.
members.speakLineZh: 同化開放規範但不抹掉異議。

members.speakLineEn: A facsimile PDF is not editable raw data.
members.speakLineZh: 傳真式 PDF 不是可編輯原始資料。

members.senseAnchor: not similar; not alike or similar
members.speakLineEn: Dissimilar cohorts need stratified claims.
members.speakLineZh: 不相似世代需要分層主張。

members.senseAnchor: a figure of speech that expresses a resemblance between things of different kinds (usually formed with `like' or `as')
members.speakLineEn: A simile in the intro is not identification.
members.speakLineZh: 導論明喻不是識別策略。

members.speakLineEn: A semblance of rigor is still fog.
members.speakLineZh: 嚴謹的外表仍是霧。

members.senseAnchor: the quality of being true or real
members.speakLineEn: Verisimilitude in examples helps teaching.
members.speakLineZh: 例子逼真有助教學。

members.speakLineEn: Do not edit code and results simultaneously unchecked.
members.speakLineZh: 不要同時改碼與結果且不檢查。

flow.content: similar／similarity 長得很像。simulate／simulation 用替身拍危險戲。simultaneous 多機同時開拍。assimilate 把新人同化進劇組；facsimile 傳真複本；dissimilar 根本不是同一劇——導演：simulate 可以，假資料不行；facsimile ≠ 原始檔。

clusters.hook: 字根 sol＝獨／日——日照廳既辦獨奏，也開日照；寂寞與陽光同一個票口。
clusters.script: solo／soloist／solitary／sole 獨奏席。desolate／solace 荒涼與安慰劑。solar／parasol 日照與遮陽傘——廳長：sole primary endpoint；solitary genius 神話退場。

members.speakLineEn: No solo decisions on outcome swaps.
members.speakLineZh: 結局替換禁止獨斷。

members.speakLineEn: Even a star soloist needs an orchestra of checks.
members.speakLineZh: 明星獨奏也需要檢查樂團。

members.speakLineEn: Solitary reanalyses invite silent bias.
members.speakLineZh: 孤獨再分析誘發沉默偏差。

members.speakLineEn: Name the sole primary endpoint in ink.
members.speakLineZh: 用墨水寫明唯一主要終點。

members.senseAnchor: leave someone who needs or counts on you; leave in the lurch; reduce in population
members.speakLineEn: A desolate methods section fails readers.
members.speakLineZh: 荒涼的方法段對不起讀者。

members.speakLineEn: Open data is solace after a null.
members.speakLineZh: 開放資料是虛無之後的安慰。

members.speakLineEn: Solar-clear figures beat ornate darkness.
members.speakLineZh: 日照般清晰的圖勝過華麗黑暗。

members.speakLineEn: Use a parasol of sensitivity analyses.
members.speakLineZh: 撑起敏感度分析陽傘。

members.speakLineEn: Do not decide alone after seeing results.
members.speakLineZh: 看到結果後不要單獨決定。

members.speakLineEn: Lonely variables still need definitions.
members.speakLineZh: 寂寞變數仍需定義。

members.speakLineEn: Keep assumptions sunlit in the paper.
members.speakLineZh: 讓假設在論文裡被陽光照射。

members.speakLineEn: Spotlight limitations as brightly as wins.
members.speakLineZh: 限制與勝利一樣用聚光燈。

clusters.hook: 字根 solv＝解、鬆——實驗室專管溶解問題與責任。
clusters.script: solve 解開；dissolve 溶解散去。resolve 下決心解開／決議；absolve 解除罪責。soluble 可溶，solvent 溶劑／有償債力。solution 解方；irresolute 猶豫不解。resolute 堅決；dissolute 放蕩無約束像道德溶解。
pitfalls: resolve 可指決心或決議，看語境
dissolute＝放蕩，不是 dissolve 的簡單形容詞

members.speakLineEn: Solve identification before claiming causation.
members.speakLineZh: 宣稱因果前先解決識別問題。

members.speakLineEn: Trust can dissolve after one opaque correction.
members.speakLineZh: 一次不透明勘誤就能溶解信任。

members.speakLineEn: Resolve disputes with shared code, not status.
members.speakLineZh: 用共享程式碼解決爭議，非地位。

members.senseAnchor: grant remission of a sin to; let off the hook
members.speakLineEn: A disclaimer does not absolve sloppy measurement.
members.speakLineZh: 免責聲明不解脫草率測量。

members.speakLineEn: Not every conflict is soluble by more data.
members.speakLineZh: 不是每個衝突都能靠更多資料溶解。

members.senseAnchor: a liquid substance capable of dissolving other substances; a statement that solves a problem or explains how to solve the problem
members.speakLineEn: A solvent explanation dissolves the paradox.
members.speakLineZh: 有力解釋能溶解悖論。

members.speakLineEn: The solution was narrower inclusion criteria.
members.speakLineZh: 解方是更窄的納入標準。

members.senseAnchor: uncertain how to act or proceed
members.speakLineEn: Irresolute leadership stalls preregistration norms.
members.speakLineZh: 猶豫領導拖延預註冊規範。

members.speakLineEn: Be resolute about sharing negative results.
members.speakLineZh: 對分享陰性結果要堅決。

members.speakLineEn: A dissolute citation culture ignores primary sources.
members.speakLineZh: 放蕩的引用文化忽略一手來源。

members.speakLineEn: Pass a resolution requiring data deposits.
members.speakLineZh: 通過要求寄存資料的決議。

members.speakLineEn: Some ethical trade-offs remain insoluble.
members.speakLineZh: 有些倫理取捨仍然無解。

clusters.hook: 字根 somn＝睡——睡眠實驗室專管失眠、催眠與夢遊決策。
clusters.script: insomnia 研究員徹夜改圖。somnolent 會議睡著。somnambulist 夢遊按了提交。hypnosis／somniferous 催眠與催睡藥味——護士：insomnia 改碼會出錯；別 somnambulist 式上線。

members.speakLineEn: Insomnia coding breeds silent bugs.
members.speakLineZh: 失眠寫碼滋生沉默錯誤。

members.speakLineEn: Somnolent review misses swaps.
members.speakLineZh: 昏昏欲睡的審查錯過替換。

members.speakLineEn: Do not be a somnambulist deployer.
members.speakLineZh: 不要當夢遊部署者。

members.speakLineEn: Somniferous prose hides the estimand.
members.speakLineZh: 催睡文風掩蓋目標量。

members.speakLineEn: Hype can feel like hypnosis—wake up to n.
members.speakLineZh: 炒作像催眠——用樣本叫醒。

members.speakLineEn: Do not ship while half asleep.
members.speakLineZh: 半睡不要上線。

members.speakLineEn: Drowsy ethics training helps no one.
members.speakLineZh: 昏沉倫理訓練幫不了人。

members.speakLineEn: A nap beats a reckless push.
members.speakLineZh: 小睡勝過魯莽推送。

members.speakLineEn: Dream results need waking replications.
members.speakLineZh: 夢境結果需要醒著的複現。

members.speakLineEn: Stay awake to interim peeking risks.
members.speakLineZh: 對期中偷看風險保持清醒。

members.speakLineEn: Sleepwalk peer review is negligence.
members.speakLineZh: 夢遊式同儕審查是疏忽。

members.speakLineEn: A methods lullaby of jargon puts readers under.
members.speakLineZh: 行話搖籃曲催眠讀者。

clusters.hook: 字根 son＝聲——錄音棚管共鳴、刺耳、齊聲與超音波。
clusters.script: sonic／sonorous／supersonic／ultrasonic 聲浪層。resonate／resonance／resonant 共鳴牆。unison 齊聲；dissonant／dissonance／assonant 刺耳與諧音——導播：let claims resonate with evidence；dissonant incentives 調音。

members.speakLineEn: Sonic branding cannot replace methods.
members.speakLineZh: 聲音品牌取代不了方法。

members.speakLineEn: Sonorous abstracts still need numbers.
members.speakLineZh: 洪亮摘要仍需要數字。

members.speakLineEn: Let limitations resonate as loudly as wins.
members.speakLineZh: 讓限制與勝利一樣共鳴。

members.speakLineEn: Emotional resonance is not causal ID.
members.speakLineZh: 情緒共鳴不是因果識別。

members.senseAnchor: characterized by resonance; serving to bring to mind; - Wilder Hobson
members.speakLineEn: Resonant stories need boring audits.
members.speakLineZh: 共鳴故事需要無聊稽核。

members.speakLineEn: Lock endpoints in unison across sites.
members.speakLineZh: 跨站點齊聲鎖定終點。

members.speakLineEn: Dissonant incentives distort reporting.
members.speakLineZh: 不和諧誘因扭曲報告。

members.speakLineEn: Cognitive dissonance after a null is data.
members.speakLineZh: 虛無後的認知失調也是資料。

members.speakLineEn: Assonant slogans are not analyses.
members.speakLineZh: 諧音口號不是分析。

members.speakLineEn: Supersonic deadlines still need checklists.
members.speakLineZh: 超音速期限仍需要清單。

members.speakLineEn: Use ultrasonic detail on edge cases.
members.speakLineZh: 對邊界案例用超音波級細節。

members.speakLineEn: Echo chambers amplify unreplicated claims.
members.speakLineZh: 回音室放大未複現主張。
